a: En kofin et hammocher limkor zimna achariti. veim amar lo: "al menat" – kofin et hammocher limkor.

Amar mar: hallokeach sade beshem chavero – en kofin et hammocher limkor zimna achariti. peshita! mahu detema, matze amar leh: midda yadat daana lenafshay shakelna – ufanchayya bealma hu dekavaena, vezuzi bichdi la shadena, ella addata dechatev leh shetara acharina; ka mashma lan deamar leh: inyayna avadi lach bahade hahu dizvant leh bishmeh, veyichtov lach shetara acharina.

Veim amar lo "al menat" – kofin et hammocher limkor. peshita! la tzericha, daamar lehu lesahadi kammeh dideh: chazo dishtara acharina ka vaena. mahu detema, matze amar leh: amena, shetara mehayech deka shaklat bishmeh kaamrat; ka mashma lan daamar leh: lehachi terachi vaamari lehu leedim kammach, deminnach hu deka vaena.

Rav kahana yehav zuza akkittana. lesof iyyaykkar kittana, zabbeneh maravoteh dechittana. ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: ma ebed, ezil eshkoyl zuzay? amar leh: i ki ka [m]zabbeni amri: "hay kittana dechahana hu" – zil shekol; vei la – la tishkol.
Keman? kivne mareva, deamri: mi hodio levaal chittin – sheyyakne chittin levaal maot?
Attu mi yahev rav kahana arba, veshakel tamne?! kittana mimmela hu deiyyaykkar; migzal gazlu, utenan: kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela!
Amri: hatam amana havay, vela mashcheh rav kahana lechittana; verav letameh, daamar rav: osin amana beferot, veen osin amana bedamim.
Mishna haggozel et chavero shave peruta, venishba lo – yolichennu acharav lemaday. lo yitten lo livno, velo lishlucho, aval noten lishliach bet din. veim met – yachazir leyorshav.

Natan lo et hakkeren, velo natan lo et hachomesh; machal lo al hakkeren, velo machal lo al hachomesh; machal lo al ze veal ze, chutz mippachut shave peruta bakkeren – eno tzarich lelech acharav. natan lo et hachomesh, velo natan lo et hakkeren; machal lo al hachomesh, velo machal lo al hakkeren; machal lo al ze veal ze, chutz mishshave peruta bakkeren – tzarich lelech acharav.
Natan lo et hakkeren, venishba lo al hachomesh –
b: Hare ze meshallem chomesh al chomesh, ad sheyyitmaet hakkeren mishshave peruta.
Vechen befikkadon, shenneemar: "o befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel, o ashak et amito o matza aveda; vechichesh bah venishba al shaker" – hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh veasham.

Gemara nishba lo – in, lo nishba lo – la; manni? la rabbi tarfon vela rabbi akiva! detanya: gazal echad mechamishsha veeno yodea eze mehen, vechol echad omer: "oti gazal" – manniach gezela benehem umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer: lo zo derech motziato mide avera, ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol echad [veechad].
Manni? i rabbi tarfon – af al gav deishteva, amar: manniach gezela benehem umistallek! i rabbi akiva – af al gav dela ishteva, amar: ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad!
Leolam rabbi akiva hi, vechi kaamar rabbi akiva ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad – hecha deishteva hu dekaamar. may tama? deamar kera: "laasher hu lo, yittenennu beyom ashmato".

Verabbi tarfon – af al gav deishteva, avud rabbanan takkanta. detanya, rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer: takkana gedola hitkinu, sheim hayta hotzaa yetera al hakkeren – meshallem keren vachomesh levet din, umevi ashamo umitkapper lo.

Verabbi akiva – ki avud rabbanan takkanta, hecha deyada leman gazleh, deka mahdar leh mamona lemareh; gazal echad mechamishsha, dela yada leman gazleh, dela hadar mamona lemareh – la avud rabbanan takkanta.

Metiv rav huna bar yehuda, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva al shellakach echad mechamishsha veeno yodea meeze mehen lakach – shemmanniach deme mikkach benehem umistallek. al ma nechleku? sheggazal echad mechamishsha bene adam, veeno yodea meeze mehen gazal; sherabbi tarfon omer: manniach deme gezela benehem umistallek, verabbi akiva omer: en lo takkana, ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad.
Vei salka datach deishteva, ma li lakach ma li gazal?

Veod metiv rava: maase bechasid echad shellakach mishshene bene adam velo haya yodea meeze mehen lakach, uva lifne rabbi tarfon, amar lo: hannach deme mikkachacha benehem, vehistallek. ba lifne rabbi akiva, amar lo: en lecha takkana, ad shetteshallem lechol echad veechad. vei salka datach demishteva, chasid mi mishteva beshikra?

Vechi tema demishteva vahadar have chasid, veha kol hecha deamrinan "maase bechasid echad" – o rabbi yehuda ben bava, o rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay; verabbi yehuda ben bava verabbi yehuda berabbi ilay chasidim demeikkara havo!
Ella leolam rabbi tarfon hi, umode rabbi tarfon hecha deishteva. may tama? deamar kera: "laasher hu lo, yittenennu beyom ashmato". verabbi akiva deamar af al gav dela mishteva – kanes.

Verabbi tarfon, mikkede hecha demishteva – la saggi dela hoda; may irya "venishba"? afillu bela shevua name! detanya, mode rabbi tarfon beomer lishnayim: "gazalti echad mikkem mane veeni yodea eze mikkem" – noten laze mane velaze mane,

a: Shekkevar hoda mippi atzmo!

Ella amar rava: shane matnitin, dechevan deyada leman gazleh, veodi leh; kevan deefshar leahdore mamona lemareh – have leh keman deamar leh: "yihyu li beyadcha". hilkach, nishba – af al gav dekaamar leh: "yihyu li beyadcha", kevan devae kappara, la saggi ad demate lideh; ha la ishteva – have gabbeh pikkadon, ad deate veshakel leh.
Lo yitten lo livno velo lishlucho. ittemar: shaliach sheasao beedim – rav chisda amar: have shaliach, rabba amar: la have shaliach.

Rav chisda amar have shaliach – lehachi terachi veokmeh beedim, deleku birshuteh. rabba amar la have shaliach – hachi kaamar: inish mehemna hu; i samchat – semoch, i baet leshaddore bideh – shaddar bideh.
Tenan: hashshoel et happara, veshillechah beyad beno, beyad avdo, beyad shelucho; o beyad beno, beyad avdo, beyad shelucho shel shoel; umeta – patur.
Hay shelucho hechi dame? i delo (asa) [asao] beedim, mena yadinan? ella (deasa) [daasao] beedim – vekatane defatur? kashya lerav chisda!
Kidamar rav chisda: bischiro ulekito, hacha name bischiro ulekito.
Tenan: lo yitten lo livno velo lishlucho. hay shelucho hechi dame? i dela asao beedim, mena yadinan? ella lav daasao beedim? targema rav chisda: bischiro ulekito.
Aval shaliach sheasao beedim – may, hachi name dehave shaliach? addetane sefa: aval noten hu lishliach bet din; liflog velitne bedideh – shaliach sheasao beedim, hachi name dehave shaliach!

Amri: la pesika leh; sheliach bet din, la shena asao nigzal vela shena asao gazlan, have shaliach – pesika leh. sheliach sheasao beedim, dechi asao nigzal hu dehave shaliach, asao gazlan la have shaliach – la pesika leh.
Uleappoke mehay tanna – detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: sheliach bet din sheasao nigzal velo asao gazlan, o asao gazlan veshalach halla venatal et shello miyyado – patur.
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: shaliach sheasao beedim, have shaliach. veim tomar mishnatenu;
Bemamtzi lo shaliach, daamar leh: "it li zuze gabbe felanya, vela ka meshaddar lehu. itchazi leh, dilma inish hu dela mashkach leshaddore leh".
I name, kidrav chisda – bischiro ulekito.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel:
b: En meshallechin maot bidyokne, vaafillu edim chatumim aleha. verabbi yochanan amar: im edim chatumim aleha – meshallechin.

Amri: lishmuel may takkanta? ki ha derabbi abba have massek zuze bidrav yosef bar chama, amar leh lerav safra: bahade deatet, ayytinhu nihali. ki azal lehatam, amar leh rava bereh: mi katav lach: "hitkabbalti"? amar leh: la. i hachi, zil beresha, veyichtov lach "hitkabbalti".

Lesof amar leh: i katav lach name "hitkabbalti", lav kelum hu; dilma addeatet shachev rabbi abba, venaflu zuze kamme yatme, vehitkabbalti" derabbi abba lav kelum hu. amar leh: veella may takkanta? zil nakninhu lach aggav ara, veta at ketov lan "hitkabbalti".
Ki ha derav pappa hava massek teresar alfe zuze be chozae, akninhu nihaleh lerav shemuel bar abba aggav assippa deveteh. ki ata, nefak leappeh ad tevach.
Natan lo et hakkeren vechulei. alma chomesh mamona hu, veim mayet – meshallemi leh yorshin.
Utenan name: natan et hakkeren venishba al hachomesh – hare mosif chomesh al chomesh. alma chumesha mamona hu.
Vetanya name hachi: haggozel et chavero, venishba lo, vamet – yorshin meshallemim keren vachomesh, ufeturin min haasham.

Veyorshin bene shallome chumesha daavuhon havu – alma chomesh mamona hu, uvae shallome yorshin. ureminhu, adayin ani omer: ematay eno meshallem chomesh al gezel aviv – bizman shello nishba lo hu velo aviv;
Hu velo aviv, aviv velo hu, hu veaviv – minnayin? talmud lomar: "asher gazal vaasher ashak" – vehu lo gazal velo ashak.
Amar rav nachman: la kashya; kan shehoda, kan shello hoda.
I lo hoda, keren name la meshallem! vechi tema: hachi name dela meshallem; veha middeka mehaddar achomesh – lememra dekeren meshallem!

Veod tanya, vaadayin ani omer: ematay hu meshallem keren al gezel aviv – bizman shennishba hu veaviv. aviv velo hu, hu velo aviv, lo hu velo aviv – minnayin? talmud lomar: gezela vaoshek, aveda ufikkadon – yesh talmud.
Veyatev rav huna vekaamar leha shemata. amar leh rabba bereh: "yesh talmud" kaamar mar, o "yishtalmu" kaamar mar? amar leh: "yesh talmud" kaamena, umeribbuya dikrae amari.
Ella may "lo hoda"? lo hoda aviv, vehoda beno.
Venichayyayv beno chomesh ashshevua dideh! amri: besheen gezela kayyemet. i besheen gezela kayyemet, afillu keren name la meshallem! la tzericha, deikka achrayut.
Vechi ikka achrayut nechasim may have? milva al pe hi, umilva al pe eno gove lo min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot!
Amri:

a: Besheamad baddin. i besheamad baddin, afillu chomesh name meshallem! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: lefi sheen meshallemin chomesh al kefirat shibud karkaot.
Rava amar: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta disakkayyay shel aviv mufekedet beyad acherim; keren meshallem – deha iteh, chomesh la meshallem – dechi ishteva bekusheta ishteva, deha la hava yada.
Chutz mippachot shave peruta bakkeren kulei. amar rav pappa: lo shanu ella sheen gezela kayyemet, aval gezela kayyemet – tzarich lelech acharav; chayyshinan shemma tiyyaykker.
Ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: la shena gezela kayyemet vela shena sheen gezela kayyemet – eno tzarich lelech acharav; leshemma tiyyaykker la chayyshinan.

Amar rava: gazal shalosh aguddot beshalosh perutot, vehuzelu veamdu al shetayim; im hechzir lo shetayim – chayyayv lehachazir lo acheret. vetanna tuna: gazal chametz veavar alav happesach – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".

Tama deiteh beeneh; ha leteh beeneh, af al gav dehashta lav mamona, kevan demeikkara mamona hu – bae shallome; hacha name, af al gav dehashta lo shave peruta [kevan demeikkara have shave peruta] – bae shallome.
Bae rava: gazal shete aguddot, bifruta vehechzir lo achat mehen – mahu? mi amrinan: hasheta lekka gezela; o dilma, ha la [a]hedar gezela dahavay gabbeh?
Hadar pashta: gezela en kan, hashava en kan. i gezela en kan – hashava yesh kan! hachi kaamar: af al pi sheggezela en kan, mitzvat hashava en kan.

Veamar rava, hare amru: nazir sheggillach veshiyyer shete searot – lo asa velo chelum; bae rava: gillach achat venashra achat, mahu? amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: nazir sheggillach achat achat ka mibbaya leh lerava?!

Amar leh: la tzericha, kegon shennashra[5] achat mehen, vegillach achat; mi amrinan: hasheta mihat ha lekka shiur; o dilma, ha lav gilluach hu – demeikkara ha shayyayr shete searot, vehasheta ki gillach la have shete searot?
Hadar pashta: sear en kan, gilluach en kan. i sear en kan – gilluach yesh kan! hachi kaamar: af al pi shessear en kan, mitzvat gilluach en kan.
Veamar rava, hare amru: chavit shennikkeva, usetamuha shemarim – hitztziluha. bae rava: agaf chetzyah, mahu?

Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: lav mishnatenu hi zo? ditnan: chavit shennikkeva usetamuha shemarim – hitztziluha. pekakah bizmora – ad sheyyemarach. hayu bah shetayim – ad sheyyemarach min hatztzedadim, uven zemora lachavertah.
Tama demarach, ha la marach – la; ammay? vetihve ki agaf chetzyah!
Amri: hachi hasheta?! hatam – i la marach la kae, agaf chetzyah – bemidde dekae kae.
Veamar rava, hare amru: gazal chametz veavar alav happesach – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha". bae rava:
b: Nishba alav, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan dei miggenev bae shallome leh – mamona ka chafar leh; o dilma, hasheta mihat ha mannach veafra bealma hu, vela kafar leh mamona?
Milleta deibbaya leh lerava, peshita leh lerabba – deamar rabba: "shori ganavta", vehu omer: "lo ganavti";
"Ma tivo etzlecha?" "shomer chinnam ani alav" – chayyayv, shehare patar atzmo miggeneva vaaveda.
"Shomer sachar ani alav" – chayyayv, shehare patar atzmo mishshevura umeta.
"Shoel ani alav" – chayyayv, shehare patar atzmo mimmeta mechamat melacha.

Alma af al gav deha kaem – kevan dei miggenev mamona ka chafar, hasheta name mamona ka chafar; hacha name, af al gav deafra bealma hu – kevan dei miggeniv bae shallome leh mamona mealleya, hasheta name mamona ka chafar leh.
Yatev rava vekaamar leha shemata. etiveh rav amram lerava: "vechichesh bah" – perat lemode baikkar.
Ketzad? "shori ganavta", vehu omer: "lo ganavti";

"Ma tivo etzlecha?" "atta mecharto li"; "atta netatto li bemattana"; "avicha mecharo li"; "avicha netano li bemattana"; "achar parati ratz"; "meelav ba etzli"; "toe badderech metzativ"; "shomer chinnam ani alav"; "shomer sachar ani alav"; "shoel ani alav" – venishba vehoda; yachol yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "vechichesh bah" – perat lemode baikkar.
Amar leh: tedora! ki tanya hahi – dekaamar leh: "helach", ki kaamena – dekayyma baagam.
"Atta mecharto li" – may mode baikkar ikka? la tzericha, deamar leh: "lo natatti lecha deme, shekoyl torach vezil".
"Atta netatto li"; "avicha netano li" – may mode baikkar ikka? deamar leh: "al menat deavedna lach neyaych denafsha, vela avadi lach, shekoyl torach vezil".
"Toe badderech metzativ" – lema: ibbei lach leahadoreh li! amar avu dishmuel, beomer: "shevua – aveda matzati, velo hayiti yodea shehi shellecha sheachzirenna lach".
Tanya, amar ben azzay: shalosh shevuot hen – hikkir bah velo bemotzah, bemotzah velo bah, lo bah velo bemotzah.
Lo bah velo bemotzah?! kusheta ishteva! ema: bah uvemotzah.
Lemay hilcheta? rav amme amar rabbi chanina: liftur, ushemuel amar: lechiyyuv.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: hammashbia ed echad – patur, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mechayyev.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: davar haggorem lemamon – kemamon dame, umar savar: lav kemamon dame.

Amar rav sheshet: hakkofer befikkadon – naase alav gazlan, vechayyayv baonasin. vetanna tuna: "vechichesh bah" – lamadnu onesh. azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo techachashu". may, lav leonesh mamon?

La, leonesh shevua. ha middekatane sefa veishteva, mikkelal deresha dela ishteva – dekatane sefa: "venishba al shaker" – lamadnu onesh. azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo teshakkeru". umiddesefa deishteva, resha dela ishteva!
Amri: idde veidde deishteva; kan shehoda, kan shebbau edim. ato edim – chayyayv beunesin. odoye odi – chayyayv bekeren vechomesh veasham.
Metiv rame bar chama: veshekkenegdo chashud al hashshevua – ketzad? echad shevuat haedut, veechad shevuat happikkadon, vaafillu shevuat shav.
Veim ita, bichfira hu deippesil leh!
Amri: hacha bemay askinan – dekae baagam, delav kefira hu; desavar: ishtemitna leh addeazelna umayytena leh.
Tidda, deamar rav idi bar avin: hakkofer bemilva – kasher leedut.

a: Befikkadon – pasul leedut.
Vehaamar ilfa: shevua kona: shevua hi dekanya, aval kefira la kanya! hacha name – dekayyma baagam.

Veibbaet ema: may "shevua kona" – kidrav huna; deamar rav huna amar rav: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer: "en lecha beyadi"; venishba, veachar kach bau edim – patur, shenneemar: "velakach bealav velo yeshallem" – kevan shekkibbelu habbealim shevua, shuv en meshallem mamon.

Gufa. amar rav huna amar rav: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer: "en lecha beyadi kelum"; venishba, uvau edim – patur, shenneemar: "velakach bealav velo yeshallem" – kevan shekkibbelu bealim shevua, shuv en meshallemin mamon.
Amar rava: mistabbera milleteh derav – bemilva, dilhotzaa nittena; aval pikkadon – birshuteh demareh kae. vehaelohim – amar rav afillu befikkadon; dechi ketiv kera – befikkadon ketiv.

Yatev rav nachman vekaamar leha shemata. etiveh rav acha bar minyome lerav nachman: "hechan pikdoni?" amar lo: "avad". "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen", vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo – meshallem et hakkeren. hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham!

Amar leh rav nachman: hacha bemay askinan – kegon denishba chutz levet din. amar leh: i hachi, ema sefa: "hechan pikdoni"? amar lo: "nignav". "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen", vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo – meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham. vei salka datach chutz levet din, mi ikka kefel?
Amar leh, yachelna leshannoye lach: resha chutz levet din, vesefa bevet din; mihu shinnuya dechika la meshannena lach. idde veidde bevet din – vela kashya; kan bekafatz, kan beshello kafatz.
Amar leh rame bar chama lerav nachman: mikkede derav la sevira lach, mashkone nafshach adderav lema lach? amar leh: lefarosha lidrav, derav hachi metaretz la lematnitin.
Veha rav kera kaamar! amri: kera lechol hannishbain shebbattora – nishbain velo meshallemin" hu daata, "velakach bealav velo yeshallem" – mi shealav leshallem, hu nishba.

Metiv rav hamenuna: hishbia alav chamishsha peamim, ben bifne bet din uven shello bifne bet din, vechafar alav – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. veamar rabbi shimon: ma taam? hoil veyachol lachazor ulehodot!
Vehacha, kafatz la matzet amrat – "hishbia alav" katane; chutz levet din la matzet amrat – "bifne bet din" katane!
Hu motev la, vehu mefarek la; litzdadin katane: hishbia alav – chutz levet din, uvevet din – kafatz.

Metiv rava: baal habbayit shettaan taanat gannav befikkadon venishba, vehoda, uvau edim – im ad shello bau edim hoda, meshallem keren vachomesh veasham; veim mishshebbau edim hoda, meshallem tashlume chefel veasham.
Vehacha chutz levet din vekafatz la matzet amrat – "kefel" katane!
Ella amar rava: kol hoda, la shena toen taanat avad, vela shena toen taanat gannav – name la amar rav, deha ketiv "vehitvadda" – devae shallome keren vachomesh.
Toen taanat gannav uvau edim name la amar rav – deha ketiv tashlume chefel. ki kaamar, kegon shettoen taanat avad, venishba velo hoda, uvau edim.
Azal rav gammada, veamra lishmata kammeh derav ashe. amar leh: hasheta uma rav hamenuna, talmideh derav – veyada deamar rav hoda, vekamotev hoda; veat amrat: hoda la amar rav?!
Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe, rav hamenuna hachi ka kashya leh:
b: I amrat bishlama nishba – ki ato edim michayyayv, ammetu lehachi mechayyeyvinan leh korban ashshevua batrayyta, hoil veyachol lachazor ulehodot;
Ella i amrat ki ato edim patur, mi ikka midde deillu atu sahadi umashadi beh – patur, vaanan neku nichayyeyveh korban ashshevua hoil veyachol lachazor ulehodot?! hasheta mihat la odi!
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.

Hoil vegannav meshallem tashlume chefel, vetoen taanat gannav meshallem tashlume chefel – ma gannav, shehu meshallem kefel, tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha; af toen taanat gannav befikkadon, keshehu meshallem tashlume chefel, tavach umachar meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
Ma legannav – shekken meshallem tashlume chefel shello bishvua, tomar betoen taanat gannav – sheen meshallem tashlume chefel ella bishvua?!
Amri: hekkesha hi, veen meshivin al hekkesha.
Hanicha leman deamar chad begannav vechad betoen taanat gannav, shappir. ella leman deamar hay "im yimmatze haggannav", veim lo yimmatze" – tarvayyhu betoen taanat gannav; may ikka lememar?
Amri: "gannav–haggannav".

Etiveh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: "hechan shori?" "nignav". "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen", vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo – meshallem tashlume chefel. veha hacha, dei efshar lichzayit basar belo shechita, vekatane: meshallem tashlume chefel; tashlume chefel – in, tashlume arbaa vachamishsha – la!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheachalo nevela.
Velishanne leh kegon sheachalo terefa! kerabbi meir, deamar: shechita sheenah reuya – shemah shechita.
Velishanne leh beven pekua! kerabbi meir, deamar: ben pekua taun shechita.

Velishanne leh kegon sheamad baddin, veamru lo: "tze ten lo"! deha amar rava: "tze ten lo", tavach umachar – patur. may tama? kevan defaskeh lemilleteh, vetavach umachar – have gazlan, vegazlan la meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha.
"Chayyayv atta litten lo", vetavach umachar – chayyayv. may tama? kol kamma dela pesika leh milleta, akkatti gannav hu.
Amri: velitamaych, lishanne leh beshuttaf shettavach shello middaat chavero! ella chada mittere utelata naket.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav baaveda, meshallem tashlume chefel. may tama? dichtiv: "al kol aveda asher yomar".

Etiveh rabbi abba bar memel lerabbi chiyyay bar abba: "ki yitten ish" – en netinat katan kelum. veen li ella shennetano keshehu katan, utevao keshehu katan; netano keshehu katan utevao keshehu gadol – minnayin? talmud lomar: "ad haelohim yavo devar shenehem" – ad shettehe netina utevia shavin keechad.
Veim ita, tehve name kaaveda! amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheachalo keshehu katan.

Aval keshehu gadol may, hachi name dimshallem? i hachi, additna: ad shettehe netina utevia shavin keechad, litne: ad shettehe achila utevia shavin keechad! amar leh, teni: ad shettehe achila utevia shavin keechad.
Rav ashe amar: la dame; aveda – ka atya mikkoach ben daat, veha – la atya mikkoach ben daat.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon, eno chayyayv ad sheyyichpor bemiktzat veyode bemiktzat. may tama? deamar kera: "ki hu ze". ufeliga derabbi chiyyay bar yosef – deamar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef:

a: Eruv parashiyyot katuv kan, vechi ketiv: "ki hu ze" – ammilva hu dichtiv. umay shena milva?

Kidrabba – deamar rabba, mippene ma amra tora: mode bemiktzat hattaana yishshava? chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo; vehay – bechulle[] bae denichpereh, vehay dela kafreh – mishshum deen adam meiz panav.

Uvechulle[] bae delode leh, vehay dichfar leh bemiktzat – savar: i modena leh bechulleh – tava li bechulleh; eshtemet le[] miha hasheta addehavu li zuze, ufarana. hilkach rema rachamana shevua illaveh – ki hechi delode leh bechulleh.
Vegabbe milva hu deikka lememar hachi, aval gabbe pikkadon – meiz umeiz.
Tane rame bar chama: arbaa shomrin
b: Tzerichin kefira bemiktzat vehodaa bemiktzat, veellu hen: shomer chinnam vehashshoel, nose sachar vehassocher.
Amar rava: may tama derame bar chama? shomer chinnam – behedya ketiv beh: "ki hu ze". shomer sachar – yalef "netina"–"netina" mishshomer chinnam.
Shoel – "vechi yishal", vav mosif al inyan rishon. socher – i leman deamar keshomer sachar, hayeynu shomer sachar; i leman deamar keshomer chinnam, hayeynu shomer chinnam.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon, eno chayyayv ad sheyyishlach bo yad. may tama? "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim, im lo shalach yado bimlechet reehu", mikkelal dei shalach bah yad – michayyayv; lememra divshalach bah yad askinan.

Amar lehu rabbi chiyyay bar abba, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: beomedet al avusah shanu. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi chiyyay bar abba: davka beomedet al avusah kaamar, aval shalach bah yad – kana, ushevua la mahneya beh kelum; o dilma, afillu omedet al avusah kaamar?

Amar leh: zo lo shamati, kayyotze bah shamati; deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat avad venishba, vechazar vetaan taanat gannav venishba, uvau edim – patur. may tama, lav mishshum dekana bishvua rishona?
Amar leh: la, hoil veyatza yede bealim bishvua rishona.

Ittemar name, amar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan: hattoen taanat aveda befikkadon venishba, vechazar vetaan taanat geneva venishba, uvau edim – patur, hoil veyatza yede bealim bishvua rishona.

Amar rav sheshet: hattoen taanat gannav befikkadon, kevan sheshshalach bo yad – patur. may tama? hachi kaamar rachamana: "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim, im lo shalach yado vegomer", ha shalach yado – patur.

Amar leh rav nachman, vahalo shalosh shavuot mashbiin oto: "shevua shello pashati bah"; "shevua shello shalachti bah yad"; "shevua sheenah birshuti". may, lav "shevua shello shalachti bah yad" – duvmya dishvua sheenah birshuti"? ma "shevua sheenah birshuti", ki miggalleya milleta deiteh birshuteh – chayyayv; "af shevua shello shalachti bah yad", ki miggalleya milleta dishlach bah yad – chayyayv!

Amar leh: la; "shevua shello shalachti bah yad" – dumeya deshello pashati bah". ma "shevua shello pashati bah" – ki miggalleya milleta defasha bah, patur mikkefel; af "shevua shello shalachti bah yad" – ki miggalleya milleta dishlach bah yad, patur mikkefel.
Bae rame bar chama: mamon hamechayyeyvo kefel potro min hachomesh, o dilma shevua hamechayyayvto kefel potarto min hachomesh?
Hechi dame? kegon shettaan taanat gannav venishba, vechazar vetaan taanat avad venishba;

a: Uvau edim akkammayyta, vehoda abbatrayyta. may?

Mamon hamechayyeyvo kefel potro min hachomesh – veha ichayyayv leh illaveh kefela; o dilma shevua hamechayyayvto kefel potarto min hachomesh – veha shevua batrayyta, hoil dela ka mechayyeyva leh kefela, techayyeyveh chumesha?

Amar rava: ta shema, amar leechad min hashshuk: "hechan shori shegganavta?" vehu omer: "lo ganavti". "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen". vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo – meshallem tashlume chefel. veim hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham.
Veha hacha, edim hu dimchayyeyvi leh kefela; hoda meatzmo – in, aval hoda achar edim – la;
Vei salka datach shevua hamechayyayvto kefel potarto min hachomesh, ammay hoda achar edim la? mikkedi ha shevua la ka meychayyeyva leh kefela, techayyeyveh chumesha!
Ella lav shema minna: mamon hamechayyeyvo kefel – potr(t)vo min hachomesh? shema minna.
Bae ravina: chomesh uchefela bitre gavre, may? hechi dame? kegon shemmasar shoro lishne bene adam, vetaanu bo taanat gannav. chad nishba vehoda, vechad nishba uvau edim. may?

Mi amrinan: bechad gavra kafed rachamana dela meshallem chumesha uchefela; hay neshallem kefela, vehay neshallem chumesha; o dilma, illave chad mamona kafed rachamana dela neshallem ale chumesha uchefela – vehacha name chad mamona hu? teku.

Bae rav pappa: tere chumeshe o tere chefele bechad gavra, may? hechi dame? shettaan taanat avad, venishba, vehoda, vechazar vetaan taanat avad, venishba, vehoda. i name, kegon shettaan taanat gannav, venishba, uvau edim, vechazar vetaan taanat gannav, venishba, uvau edim, may?

Mi amrinan: tere gavvne mamona kaamar rachamana dela nishtallemu illave chad mamona – vehacha chad gavvna hu; o dilma, tere mamone amar rachamana dela lishtallemu illave chad mamona – vehacha name tere mamone ninhu?
Ta shema, deamar rava: "vachamishitav yosef alav" – hattora ribbeta chamishiyyot harebe lekeren achat! shema minna.
Tevauhu bealim lashshomer, venishba, veshillem, vehukkar haggannav – kefel lemi? abbaye amar: levaal happikkadon, rava amar: lemi shehappikkadon etzlo.
Abbaye amar levaal happikkadon – kevan deatrecheh bishvua, la makne leh kefela. rava amar lemi shehappikkadon etzlo – kevan deshillem, makne leh kefela.

Veka mippalgi bediyyuka dematnitin, ditnan: hammafkid etzel chavero behema o chelim, venignevu o sheavdu; shillem velo ratza lishshava – shehare amru: shomer chinnam nishba veyotze; nimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi hu meshallem? lemi shehappikkadon etzlo.
Nishba velo ratza leshallem, venimtza haggannav – meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar – meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi hu meshallem? levaal happikkadon.
Abbaye dayek meresha, rava dayek missefa. abbaye dayek meresha – dekatane: shillem velo ratza lishshava. tama delo ratza lishshava,
b: Ha nishba – af al pi sheshshillem; lemi meshallem? levaal happikkadon.
Rava dayek missefa – nishba velo ratza leshallem. tama delo ratza leshallem, ha shillem – af al pi shennishba; lemi meshallem? lemi shehappikkadon etzlo.

Leabbaye, kashya sefa! amar lach abbaye, hachi katane: nishba, velo ratza leshallem kodem hashshevua ella leachar hashshevua, lemi meshallem? levaal happikkadon. lerava, kashya resha! amar lach rava, hachi katane: shillem, velo ratza laamod bishvuato ella shillem, lemi meshallem? lemi shehappikkadon etzlo.
Tevauhu bealim lashshomer, venishba, vehukkar haggannav; tevao shomer, vehoda; tevauhu bealim, vechafar, veheviu edim – mi niftar haggannav behodaat shomer, o lo niftar haggannav behodaat shomer?
Amar rava: im beemet nishba – niftar haggannav behodaat shomer. im besheker nishba – lo niftar haggannav behodaat shomer.
Bae rava: amad lishshava besheker velo hinnichuhu, mahu? teku. rav kahana matne hachi; rav tavyome matne – bae rava: nishba lashsheker, mahu? teku.
Tevauhu bealim lashshomer – veshillem, vehukkar haggannav, tevauhu bealim – vehoda, tevao shomer – vechafar, vehevi edim; niftar gannav behodaat bealim, o lo?

Mi amrinan matze amar leh shomer livalim: "attun, kevan deshaklitu lechu deme – isteliktu lechu mehacha"; o dilma, matze amri leh: "ki hechi deat avadt lan milleta, anan name avdinan lach – tarchinan batar gannava; (shakelna) [shaklinan] anan didan, ushekol at didach"? teku.

Ittemar: nigneva beones vehukkar haggannav, amar abbaye: im shomer chinnam hu – ratza ose immo din, ratza nishba. im shomer sachar hu – ose immo din, veeno nishba. rava amar: echad ze veechad ze – ose immo din veeno nishba.

Lema peliga adderav huna bar avin? dishlach rav huna bar avin: nigneva beones vehukkar haggannav, im shomer chinnam hu – ratza ose immo din, ratza nishba; veim shomer sachar hu – ose immo din veeno nishba.
Amar lach rava: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shekkadam venishba. veha "ratza ose immo din, ratza nishba" kaamar! hachi kaamar: ratza shomer chinnam – omed bishvuato, ratza – ose immo din.

Rabba zute bae la hachi: nigneva beones, vehechzir gannav bevet shomer, umeta bifshia, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan denigneva beones – kalya leh shemirato, o dilma kevan d[a]hedra – hadara lishmirato? teku.
Mishna "hechan pikdoni?" amar lo: "avad". "mashbiacha ani", veamar "amen", vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo – meshallem keren. [hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren vachomesh veasham.]
"Hechan pikdoni?" amar lo: "nignav". "mashbiacha ani", veamar: "amen", vehaedim meidim oto sheggenavo – meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo – meshallem keren, chomesh veasham.
Haggozel et aviv, venishba lo, vamet – hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh veasham levanav o leechav. veim eno rotze o sheen lo – love uvaale chov bain venifraim.
Haomer livno: "kunnam i atta nehene mishshelli", im met – yirashennu.

a: Bechayyav uvemoto, im met – lo yirashennu, veyachzir levanav o leechav. veim en lo – love uvaale chov baim venifraim.
Gemara amar rav yosef: afillu learnaki shel tzedaka. amar rav pappa: vetzarich sheyyomar: "ze gezel avi".
Ammay? nimchaleh lenafsheh! mi la tenan: machal lo al hakkeren velo machal lo al hachomesh? alma bar mechila hu!
Amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya; ha rabbi yose haggelili, ha rabbi akiva.
Detanya: "veim en laish goel lehashiv haasham" – vechi yesh adam beyisrael sheen lo goalim? ella begezel hagger hakkatuv medabber –

Hare sheggazal hagger, venishba lo; veshama shemmet hagger, vehaya maale kaspo vaashamo lirushalayim; ufaga beoto hagger, uzekafo alav bemilva, umet – zacha halla bema shebbeyado, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: en lo takkana ad sheyyotzi gezelo mittachat yado.
Lerabbi yose haggelili – la shena lenafsheh la shena laacherim, matze machel; ulerabbi akiva – la shena laacherim vela shena lenafsheh, la matze machel.

Ulerabbi yose – hu haddin daafillu lo zekafo bemilva, vehay dekatane "zekafo alav bemilva" – lehodiacha kocho derabbi akiva, daafillu zekafan alav bemilva, en lo takkana ad sheyyotzi gezela mittachat yado.

Matkef la rav sheshet: i hachi, lerabbi yose haggelili – lashmeinan lenafsheh, vechol shekken laacherim! lerabbi akiva – lashmeinan laacherim dela matze machel, vechol shekken lenafsheh dela matze machel!

Ella amar rav sheshet: ha veha rabbi yose haggelili; ki kaamar rabbi yose haggelili dematze machel – laacherim, aval lenafsheh – la matze machel. ella ammay zacha halla bema shebbeyado? mishshum dizkafan alav bemilva.
Rava amar: ha veha rabbi akiva; ki amar rabbi akiva dela matze machel – lenafsheh, aval laacherim – matze machel.
b: Mikkelal derabbi yose haggelili savar: afillu lenafsheh name matze machel?! ella gezel hagger dekaamar rachamana netina lechohanim, hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – kesheggazal et hagger, venishba lo, umet hagger, vehoda leachar mita; dividdana deodi – kenao hashshem unetano lechohanim.
Bae ravina: gezel haggiyyoret, mahu? "ish" amar rachamana – velo ishsha, o dilma orcheh dikra hu?
Amar leh rav aharon leravina: ta shema, detanya: "ish" – en li ella ish; ishsha minnayin? keshehu omer "hammushav" – hare kan shenayim,
Im ken ma talmud lomar "ish"? ish atta tzarich lachazor acharav im yesh lo goalim im lav, katan i atta tzarich lachazor acharav; beyadua sheen lo goalin.

Tanu rabbanan: "laAdonai lakkohen" – kenao hashshem, unetano lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar. atta omer lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar; o eno ella lechol kohen sheyyirtze? keshehu omer "millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo alav" – hare lakkohen shebbeoto mishmar hakkatuv medabber.
Tanu rabbanan: hare shehaya gozel kohen, minnayin shello yomar: hoil veyotze lakkohanim, vahare hu tachat yadi – yehe shelli? vedin hu – i beshel acherim hu zoche, beshel atzmo lo kol shekken?

Rabbi natan omer belashon acher: uma davar sheen lo chelek bo ad sheyyikkanes birshuto – kesheyyikkanes lirshuto eno yachol lehotzio miyyado; davar sheyyesh lo chelek bo ad shello yikkanes birshuto – mishshennichnas lirshuto eno din deen acher yachol lehotzio miyyado?

Lo; im amarta bedavar sheen lo chelek bo – shekkeshem sheen lo chelek bo kach en laacherim chelek bo, tomar begazel – shekkeshem sheyyesh lo chelek bo, kach yesh laacherim chelek bo?! ella gezelo yotze mittachat yado, umitchallek lechol echav hakkohanim.
Vehachtiv: "veish et kodashav lo yihyu"! hacha bemay askinan – bechohen tame.
I bechohen tame, "davar sheyyesh lo chelek bo" mi it leh?! ella atya "lakkohen"–"lakkohen" missede achuzza.

Detanya: "achuzzato" – ma talmud lomar? minnayin lesade hayyotza lakkohanim bayyovel – ugealah echad min hakkohanim, minnayin shello yomar: hoil veyotza lakkohanim bayyovel, vahare hi tachat yadi, tehe shelli?
Vedin hu – beshel acherim ani zoche, beshel atzmi lo kol shekken?!
Talmud lomar: "kisde hacherem lakkohen tihye achuzzato" – achuzza shello, veen zo shello. ha ketzad? yotza mittachat yado, umitchalleket lechol echav hakkohanim.
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin lechohen – shebba umakriv korbenotav bechol et uvechol shaa sheyyirtze? talmud lomar: "uva bechol avvat nafsho", "vesheret".
Uminnayin sheavodatah veorah shello? talmud lomar: "veish et kodashav lo yihyu". ha ketzad? im haya baal mum – notnah lechohen shebbeoto mishmar, vaavodatah veorah shello.

a: Veim haya zaken o chole – notnah lechol kohen sheyyirtze, vaavodatah veorah leanshe mishmar.
Hay zaken o chole, hechi dame? i dematze aved avoda – avodatah veorah name tehve dideh! vei dela matze aved avoda – shaliach hechi meshavve?

Amar rav pappa: sheyyachol laasot al yede haddechak. avoda – dechi aved leh al yede haddechak avoda hi, umeshavve shaliach; achila – dechi achel al yede haddechak achila gassa hi, vaachila gassa lav kelum hu; mishshum hachi avodatah veorah leanshe mishmar.

Amar rav sheshet: im haya kohen tame bekorban tzibbur – notnah lechol mi sheyyirtze, vaavodatah veorah leanshe mishmar. hechi dame? i deikka tehorim, temeim mi matzu avdi?! vei delekka tehorim, avodatah veorah leanshe mishmar?! ha temeim ninhu, vela matzu achli!
Amar rava, ema: levaale mumin tehorin shebbeoto mishmar.

Amar rav ashe: im haya kohen gadol onen – notnah lechol kohen sheyyirtze, vaavodatah veorah leanshe mishmar. may ka mashma lan? tenena: kohen gadol makriv onen, veeno ochel, veeno cholek leechol laerev!
Salka datach amena: ki chas rachamana aleh dechohen gadol – lekarove hu, aval leshauoye shaliach – la matze meshavve; ka mashma lan.

Mishna haggozel et hagger, venishba lo, vamet – hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh lakkohanim, veasham lammizbeach; shenneemar: "veim en laish goel lehashiv haasham elav, haasham hammushav laAdonai lakkohen, millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo alav".

Haya maale et hakkesef veet haasham, vamet – hakkesef yinnaten levanav, vehaasham yire ad sheyyistaev – veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. natan hakkesef leanshe mishmar, vamet – en hayyorshin yecholin lehotzi miyyadam, shenneemar: "veish asher yitten lakkohen – lo yihye".

Natan hakkesef lihoyariv, veasham lidaya – yatza. asham lihoyariv vechesef lidaya – im kayyaym haasham, yakrivuhu bene yedaya; veim lo, yachazir veyavi asham acher. shehammevi gezelo ad shello hevi ashamo – yatza; hevi ashamo ad shello hevi gezelo – lo yatza.
Natan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh – en hachomesh meakkev.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "asham" – ze keren, "hammushav" – ze chomesh. o eno ella: "asham" – ze ayil?
Ulemay nafka minna? leappoke midderava, deamar rava: gezel hagger shehechziro ballayla – lo yatza. hechziro chatzain – lo yatza. may tama? "asham" karyeh rachamana.
Keshehu omer "millevad el hakkippurim", heve omer: "asham" – ze keren.

Tanya iddach: "asham" – ze keren, "hammushav" – ze chomesh. o eno ella: "asham" – ze chomesh? lemay nafka minna? leappoke mimmatnitin, ditnan: natan lo et hakkeren velo natan lo et hachomesh – en hachomesh meakkev. adderabba, chomesh meakkev.
Keshehu omer: "veheshiv et ashamo berosho, vachamishito", heve omer: "asham" – ze keren.

Tanya iddach: "asham" – ze keren, "hammushav" – ze chomesh; uvegezel hagger hakkatuv medabber. o eno ella: "hammushav" – ze kefel, uvignevat hagger hakkatuv medabber? keshehu omer: "veheshiv et ashamo berosho, vachamishito" – hare bemamon hammishtallem barosh hakkatuv medabber.
Gufa – amar rava: gezel hagger shehechziro ballayla – lo yatza. hechziruhu chatzain – lo yatza. may tama? "asham" karyeh rachamana.
Veamar rava: gezel hagger sheen bo shave peruta lechol kohen vechohen – lo yatza yede chovato. may tama? dichtiv: "haasham hammushav" – ad sheyyehe hashava lechol kohen vechohen.
Bae rava: en bo lemishmeret yehoyariv veyesh bo
b: Lemishmeret yedaya, mahu?
Hechi dame? illema deyahaveh lidaya bemishmeret yedaya – ha it beh!
La tzericha, deyahaveh lidaya bemishmarto dihoyariv. may? mi amrinan: kevan delav mishmarto hu – vela kelum hu; o dilma, kevan dela chaze leh meikkara – lidaya kae? teku.
Bae rava: kohanim, mahu sheyyachleku gezel hagger keneged gezel hagger?
Mi amrinan: "asham" karyeh rachamana – ma asham en cholkin asham keneged asham, af gezel en cholkin gezel hagger keneged gezel hagger; o dilma, gezel hagger mamona hu?
Hadar pashta: "asham" karyeh rachamana. rav acha bereh derava matne la behedya – amar rava: kohanim en cholkin gezel hagger keneged gezel hagger. may tama? "asham" karyeh rachamana.
Bae rava: kohanim begezel hagger – yorshin havu, o mekabbele mattanot havu?

Lemay nafka minna? kegon sheggazal chametz sheavar alav happesach. i amrat yorshin havu – hayeynu hay deyarti moret. vei amrat mekabbele mattanot havu – mattana kaamar rachamana denittev lehu, veha la ka yahev lehu midde – deafra bealma hu.
Rav zeera bae hachi: afillu im timtze lomar mekabbele mattana havu, ha – la ibbaya lan, dehahi mattana amar rachamana denittev lehu.
Ella ki kamibbaya lan – kegon shennaflu lo eser behemot begezel hagger. [mi] michayyeyvi leafroshe minnayyhu maaser, o la?
Yorshin havu – deamar mar: kanu bitfisat habbayit – chayyayvin; o dilma mekabbele mattanot havu – utenan: hallokeach vehannittan lo bemattana – patur mimmasar behema. may?
Ta shema: esrim vearba mattenot kehunna nittenu leaharon ulevanav, vechullan nittenu bichlal uferat uchelal, uverit melach.
Kol hamekayyeyman – keillu mekayyem kelal uferat uchelal uverit melach, kol haover alehem – keillu over al kelal uferat uchelal uverit melach.

Veellu hen: eser bammikdash, vearba birushalayim, veeser baggevulim. eser bammikdash – chattat behema, vechattat haof, veasham vadday, veasham taluy, vezivche shalme tzibbur, velog shemen shel metzora, umotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot.
Vearba birushalayim – habbechora, vehabbikkurim, vehammuram min hattoda veel nazir, veorot kodashim.
Vaasara baggevulin: teruma, uterumat maaser, vechalla, vereshit haggez, vehammattanot, ufidyon habben, ufidyon peter chamor, usede achuzza, usede charamim, vegezel hagger.
Veka kare mihat "mattana" – shema minna mekabbele mattanot havu! shema minna.
Natan et hakkesef leanshe mishmar [vechulei]. amar abbaye: shema minna, kesef mechapper mechetza. dei la mechapper, hava amena: mahdar leyorshin. may tama? addata dehachi la yehav leh.
Ella meatta, chattat shemmetu bealeha tippok lechullin – deaddata dehachi la afresha! amri: chattat shemmetu bealeha, hilcheta gemiri la dilmita azla.
Ella meatta, asham shemmetu bealav lippok lechullin – deaddata dehachi la afresheh! asham name hilcheta gemiri lah – kol shebbachattat meta, beasham roe.
Ella meatta, yevama shennafla lifne mukke shechin tippok bela chalitza, deaddata dehachi lo kiddesha atzmah! hatam anan sahadi

a: Demenach nicha la bechol dehu – keresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: tav lemetav tan du, millemetav armelu.
Natan et hakkesef lihoyariv vechulei. tanu rabbanan: natan asham lihoyariv vechesef lidaya – yachazir kesef etzel asham, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: yachazir asham etzel kesef.
Hechi dame? illema deyahev leh asham lihoyariv bemishmarto dihoyariv, vechesef lidaya bemishmarto didaya – ze zacha beshello veze zacha beshello!

Amar rava: hacha bemay askinan – deyahev asham lihoyariv bemishmarto dihoyariv, vechesef lidaya bemishmarto dihoyariv. rabbi yehuda savar: kevan delav mishmart[vo] didaya hi – lidaya kansinan leh, hilkach yachazir kesef etzel asham; verabbanan savri: shello kaddin (hu) avud bene yehoyariv dekaybilu asham mikkamme chesef, hilkach ledidhu kansinan lehu, veyachzor asham etzel kesef.
Tanya, amar rabbi: ledivre rabbi yehuda, im kadmu bene yehoyariv vehikrivu et haasham – yachzor veyavi asham acher veyakrivuhu bene yedaya, vezachu hallalu bema shebbeyadan.
Amri: lemay chaze? asham pasul hu! amar rava: leoro.
Tanya, amar rabbi: ledivre rabbi yehuda, im kayyaym asham – yachazir asham etzel kesef.
Veha rabbi yehuda – yachazir kesef etzel asham it leh! hacha bemay askinan – kegon dinfak mishmarto dihoyariv, vela tevau. veha ka mashma lan – deachole achilu gabbayyhu.
Tanya iddach, amar rabbi: ledivre rabbi yehuda, im kayyaym asham – yachzor kesef etzel asham. peshita – hachi it leh!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon dinfak mishmartam dehane udehane, vela tevau. mahu detema achole gabbe hadade, ka mashma lan deamrinan: kevan dela tavi, lihderu beresha.

Shehammevi gezelo ad shello hevi ashamo [vechulei]. menahane mille? amar rava, deamar kera: "haasham hammushav laAdonai lakkohen, millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo" – mikkelal dechesef beresha.
Amar hahu merabbanan lerava: ella meatta, "millevad olat habboker" – hachi name mikkelal demusafin beresha?
Vehatanya: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem letamid shel shachar? talmud lomar: "vearach aleha haola", veamar rava: "haola" – ola rishona!
Amar leh: ana measher yechapper bo" nafka leh, vaadayin lo kipper.
Natan lo et hakkeren vechulei. tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim hevi meilato velo hevi ashamo; ashamo velo hevi meilato – shello yatza?
Talmud lomar: "beel haasham venislach lo".
Uminnayin sheim hevi ashamo ad shello hevi meilato, shello yatza? talmud lomar: "beel haasham" – haasham bichvar.
Yachol keshem sheayil veasham meakkevim, kach chomesh meakkev? talmud lomar: "beel haasham venislach lo" – ayil veasham meakkevim behekdesh, veen chomesh meakkev.
Veyilmad hekdesh mehedyot, vehedyot mehekdesh.
Hekdesh mehedyot – ma "asham" dehatam keren, af "asham" dehacha keren. vehedyot mehekdesh – ma hekdesh en chomesh meakkev, af hedyot name en chomesh meakkev.
Hadaran alach haggozel etzim.
b: Mishna haggozel umaachil et banav, vehinniach lifnehem – peturin milleshallem. veim haya davar sheyyesh bo achrayut – chayyayvin leshallem.
Gemara amar rav chisda: gazal velo nityayashu habbealim, uva acher vaachalo mimmennu – ratza mizze gove, ratza mizze gove. may tama? kol kamma delo nityayashu habbealim – birshuteh demareh kae.
Tenan: haggozel umaachil et banav, vehinniach lifnehem – peturin milleshallem. teyuveta derav chisda! amar lecha rav chisda: ki tanya hahi – leachar yeush.
Im hinniach lifnehem – peturin milleshallem. amar rame bar chama, zot omeret: reshut yoresh kirshut lokeach dame.
Rava amar: reshut yoresh lav kirshut lokeach dame, vehacha bemay askinan – kesheachalum.

Ha middekatane sefa: im haya davar sheyyesh bo achrayut – chayyayvin leshallem, mikkelal deresha bigzela kayyemet askinan! amar lach rava, hachi kaamar: im hinniach lahem avihem achrayut nechasim, chayyayvin leshallem.
Veha matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh: lo davar sheyyesh bo achrayut mammash; ella afillu para vechoresh bah, chamor umechammer acharav – chayyayvin lehachezir, mippene kevod avihen.

Ella amar rava: ki shachevna – rabbi oshaya nafek levoti, detaretzna matnitin kevoteh. detane rabbi oshaya: haggozel umaachil et banav – peturin milleshallem. hinniach lifnehem – gezela kayyemet, chayyayvin; en haggezela kayyemet, peturin. hinniach lahem avihem achrayut nechasim – chayyayvin leshallem.
Amar mar: en haggezela kayyemet – peturin. nema tehve teyuveta derav chisda? amar lach rav chisda: ki tanya hahi – leachar yeush.
Amar mar: gezela kayyemet – chayyayvin leshallem. nema tehve teyuveta derame bar chama? amar lach rame bar chama: ki tanya hahi –

a: Lifne yeush.

Rav adda bar ahava matne leha derame bar chama aha: hinniach lahen avihen maot shel ribbit, af al pi sheyyodin shehen shel ribbit – en chayyayvin lehachezir. amar rame bar chama, zot omeret: reshut yoresh kirshut lokeach dame.

Rava amar: leolam ema lach reshut yoresh lav kirshut lokeach dame, veshane hacha deamar kera: "al tikkach meitto neshech vetarbit" – ahdar leh, ki hechi deneche bahadach; ledideh ka mazhar leh rachamana, livreh la mazhar leh rachamana.
Man dematne la abbarayyta – kol shekken ammatnitin. man dematne la ammatnitin – aval abbarayyta, rame bar chama kerava matne la.

Tanu rabbanan: haggozel umaachil et banav – peturin milleshallem. hinniach lifnehem – gedolim, chayyayvin leshallem; ketannim, peturin milleshallem. veim amru gedolim: en anu yodin cheshbonot shechishshev avinu immach – peturin.
Mishshum deamri: "en anu yodin" – peturim?! amar rava: hachi kaamar, gedolim sheamru: yodim anu cheshbonot shechishshev avinu immach, vela pash lach gabbeh vela midde – peturin.

Tanya iddach: haggozel umaachil banav – peturin milleshallem. hinniach lifnehem vaachalum – ben gedolim ben ketannim, chayyayvin. ketannim mi michayyeyvi?! lo yehe ella deazzek azzoke! amar rav pappa, hachi kaamar: hinniach lifnehem vaadayin lo achalum – ben gedolim ben ketannim, chayyayvin.

Amar rava: hinniach lahem avihem para sheula – mishtammeshin bah kol yeme sheelatah. meta – en chayyayvin beonseha. kisvurim shel avihem hi, utevachuha vaachaluha – meshallemin deme vasar bezol. hinniach lahem avihem achrayut nechasim – chayyayvin leshallem.
Ikka dematne la aresha, veikka dematne la assefa.
Man dematne la aresha – kol shekken assefa, ufeliga derav pappa. man dematne la assefa – aval aresha la, vehayeynu derav pappa.

Deamar rav pappa: hayta para genuva lo, utevachah beshabbat – chayyayv; shekkevar chayyayv bigneva, kodem sheyyavo lide issur shabbat. hayta para sheula lo, utevachah beshabbat – patur; sheissur shabbat veissur geneva bain keechad.
Tanu rabbanan: "veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal"; ma talmud lomar "asher gazal"? yachazir keen sheggazal.
Mikkan amru: haggozel umaachil et banav – peturin milleshallem. hinniach lifnehen – ben gedolim ben ketannim, chayyayvin. mishshum somchos amru: gedolim chayyayvin, ketannim peturin.
Bar chamu derabbi yirmeya terak galla beappeh derabbi yirmeya. ata lekammeh derabbi avin,
Amar: shello hu tovea. amar leh: veha mayytina sahadi deachzaki beh bechayye daavu! amar leh: vechi mekabbelin edim
b: Shello bifne baal din?! vela? veha katane: ben gedolim ben ketannim, chayyayvin! amar leh: hare machloket somchos betziddach. amar: ikkefal kulle alma vekae kesomchos – leafkoan ledidi?

Addehachi iggalgal milleta, ata umeta lekammeh derabbi avahu. amar: la shemia lechu ha derav yosef bar chama amar rabbi oshaya? deamar rav yosef bar chama amar rabbi oshaya: tinok shettakaf baavadav, veyarad letoch sade shel chavero veamar "shelli hu", en omrim: namtin ad sheyyagdil; ella motziin miyyado miyyad, velichsheyyagdil yavi edim venire!
Mi dame? hatam hu demappekinan minneh – dela kayyma leh achazaka daavu; aval hecha deit leh chazaka daavu, la.
Amar rav ashe amar rabbi shabbetay: mekabbelin edim shello bifne baal din. tahe ba rabbi yochanan, vechi mekabbelin edim shello bifne baal din?!
Kaybla minneh rabbi yose bar chanina: kegon shehaya hu chole o edav cholim, o shehayu edav mevakkeshin lelech limdinat hayyam, veshalchu lo velo ba.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mekabbelin edim shello bifne baal din. amar mar ukeva, ledidi mipparsha li minneh dishmuel: kegon diftachu leh bedineh, ushelachu leh vela ata. aval la petachu leh bedina, matze amar leh: ana levet din haggadol azelna.
I hachi, ki fatchu leh name, matze amar leh: levet din haggadol azelna! amar ravina: kegon denaket diska mibbet din haggadol.

Amar rav: mekayyeymin et hashshetar shello bifne baal din. verabbi yochanan amar: en mekayyeymin et hashshetar shello bifne baal din. amar leh rav sheshet lerabbi yose bar avahu: asbera lach tameh derabbi yochanan – amar kera: "vehuad bivalav velo yishmerennu", amra tora: yavo baal hashshor, veyaamod al shoro.

Amar rava, hilcheta: mekayyeymin et hashshetar shello bifne baal din, vaafillu omed vetzoveach. vei amar: nekitu li zimna ad demayytena sahadi umarana leh lishtara – naktinan leh. i ata – ata, i la ata – natrinan leh sheni vachamishi vesheni;

I la ata – katvinan peticha illaveh tishin yomin. telatin kammae la nachatinan lenichseh, deamrinan: ka tarach bezuze venezof. metziae name la nachatinan leh lenichseh, deamar: dilma la ashkach lemezaf, veka tarach umezabben. batrae name la nachatinan lenichseh, deamar: lokeach gufeh ka tarach bezuze.
La ata – katvinan adrachta annichseh. vehane mille daamar "atena", aval amar "la atena" – lealtar katvinan.
Vehane mille bemilve, aval befikkadon – lealtar katvinan.
Vechi katvinan – ammekarkee, aval ammittalteli – la; dilma shamet veachel lehu malve lemittaltele, vechi ate love umayyte sahadi umara leh lishtara – la mashkach midde lemigbe.
Vei it leh mekarkee lemalve – katvinan. vela hi; adrachta ammittalteli la katvinan, af al gav deit leh mekarkee; chayyshinan shemma tachsif.
Vechi katvinan adrachta – modinan leh. vehane mille dimykarav, aval merachak – la.

Vei merachak veikka kerovim, i name ikka sheyayrata deazli veatu hatam, meshahenan leh teresar yarche shatta ad deazla veate sheyayra. ki ha deravina sheha lemar acha teresar yarche shatta, ad deazla veatyay sheyayra mibbe chozae.

Vela hi; hatam – inish allima hava, i haveya matya adrachta lideh la hava efshar leappoke minneh. aval hacha – la natrinan leh ella ad deazel shelicha bitlata beshabbeta veate bearbea beshabbeta, ulechamsha beshabbeta kae bedineh.
Amar ravina: hay shelucha derabbanan, mehemninan leh keve tere. vehane mille leshamta, aval lifticha – kevan demamona ka mechassar leh, deka vae leh lemittav leh zuze lesafra – la.
Amar ravina: yahavinan zimna appumma deitteta veippuma deshivave. vela amaran ella deleteh bemata,

a: Aval iteh bemata – la; deamrinan: emar la amaru leh, deamri: (ashkechinhu) [ashkecheh] shelicha devet din, vaamar leh.
Vela amaran ella dela chalef abbava deve dina, aval chalef abbava deve dina – la; amri: ashkechu be dina, veamri leh.
Vela amaran ella deate beyomeh, aval la ate beyomeh – la; ema ishteloye ishteli.
Amar rava: hay man dichtiv aleh peticha al dela ate ledina – ad deate ledina, la mekarinan leh. al dela tzayet ledina – ad detzayet, la mekarinan leh. vela hi, kevan deamar: "tzayetna" – karinan leh.
Amar rav chisda: kovim zeman sheni vachamishi vesheni – zimna vezimna batar zimna, ulemachar katvinan.
Rav assi ikkela be rav kahana. chaza hahi itteta deazmena ledina befanya, uvetzafra ketuyv ala peticha. amar leh, la savar la mar leha deamar rav chisda: kovin zeman sheni vachamishi vesheni?
Amar leh: hane mille gavra, daanis veleteh bemata; aval itteta, kevan deita bemata vela atya – moredet hi.

Amar rav yehuda: la (yahavina) [yahavinan] zimna la beyome nisan vela beyome tishre, la bemaale yoma tava vela bemaale shabbeta. aval minnisan levatar yome nisan, uveyome tishre levatar tishre – kavinan. mimmaale shabbeta levatar maale shabbeta – la kavinan. may tama? baavidteh deshabbeta terid.

Amar rav nachman: la yahavinan zimna la livne challa bechalla, vela livne rigla berigla. ki havo atu lekammeh derav nachman, amar lehu: vechi ledidchu kinnufayychu?! vehaiddana deikka rammae – chayyshinan.

Im haya devar sheyyesh bo achrayut – chayyayv leshallem. matne leh rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh: lo davar sheyyesh bo achrayut mammash, ella afillu para vechoresh bah, chamor umechammer acharav – chayyayvin lehachazir, mippene kevod avihen.
Bae minneh rav kahana merav: mitta umesev aleha, shulechan veochel alav, mahu? amar lo: "ten lechacham veyechkam od".
Mishna en portin lo mittevat hammochsin, velo mikkis shel gabbain, veen notlin mehem tzedaka. aval notel hu mittoch beto o min hashshuk.
Gemara tana: aval noten lo dinar, venoten lo et hashshear.
Umochsin. vehaamar shemuel: dina demalchuta dina!
Amar rabbi chanina bar kahana amar shemuel: bemoches sheen lo kitzva. deve rabbi yannay amri: bemoches haomed meelav.

Ikka dematne la aha: lo yilbash adam kilayim afillu al gabbe asara begadim, lehaveriach bo et hammeches. matnitin dela kerabbi akiva. detanya: asur lehaveriach et hammeches. rabbi shimon omer mishshum rabbi akiva: muttar lehaveriach et hammeches.

Bishlama leinyan kilayim, beha kamippalgi – demar savar: davar sheen mitkavven muttar, umar savar: davar sheen mitkavven asur. ella lehaveriach bo et hammeches – mi shere? vehaamar shemuel: dina demalchuta dina!
Amar rabbi chanina bar kahana amar shemuel: bemoches sheen lo kitzva. deve rabbi yannay amri: bemoches haomed meelav.

Veikka dematne aha: nodrin leharagin velecharamin velammochsin – shehi shel teruma, shehi shel bet melech; af al pi sheenah shel teruma, af al pi sheenah shel melech: velammochsin?! vehaamar shemuel: dina demalchuta dina!
Amar rabbi chanina bar kahana amar shemuel: bemoches sheen lo kitzva. deve rabbi yannay amri: bemoches haomed meelav.

Rav ashe amar: bemoches goy. detanya: yisrael vegoy shebbau laddin, im atta yachol lezakkoto bedine yisrael – zakkehu, veemor lo: kach dinenu. bedine goyim – zakkehu veemor lo: kach dinchem. veim lav, bain alav baakifin; divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: en bain alav baakifin, mippene kiddush hashshem.
Verabbi akiva – tama deikka kiddush hashshem, ha lekka kiddush hashshem – bain;
Vegezel goy mi shere? vehatanya: amar rabbi shimon, devar ze darash rabbi akiva keshebba mizzefirin: minnayin legezel goy shehu asur? talmud lomar: "achare nimkar, geulla tihye lo" –
b: Shello yimshechennu veyetze. yachol yiglom alav? talmud lomar: "vechishshav im konehu" – yedakdek im konehu!
Amar rav yosef: la kashya; ha, begoy, ha beger toshav.
Amar leh abbaye, veha tarvayyhu gabbe hadade ketivi: lo lecha, ella leger – shenneemar: "leger". velo leger tzedek, ella leger toshav – shenneemar: "leger toshav".
"Mishpachat ger" – ze haggoy; keshehu omer: "o leeker" – ze hannimkar laavoda zara!
Ella amar rava: la kashya; kan bigzelo, vechan behafekaat halevoato.
Amar leh abbaye: eved ivri – hafekaat halevoato hu! rava letameh, deamar rava: eved ivri gufo kanuy.

Amar rav bivi bar giddel amar rabbi shimon chasida: gezel goy asur, avedato mutteret. gezelo asur – deamar rav huna: minnayin legezel haggoy shehu asur? shenneemar: "veachalta et kol haammim asher Adonai elohecha noten lach" – bizman shehen mesurim beyadcha, velo bizman sheenam mesurin beyadcha.
Avedato mutteret – deamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: minnayin laavedat haggoy shehi mutteret? shenneemar: "lechol avedat achicha" – leachicha atta machzir, vei atta machzir legoy.

Veema hane mille hecha dela atay lideh, dela michayyayv leahdore batra; aval hecha deate lideh, ema layhdera! amar ravina: "umetzatah" – daatay lideh mashma. tanya, rabbi pinchas ben yair omer: bemakom sheyyesh chillul hashshem, afillu avedato asur.
Amar shemuel: tauto mutteret. ki ha dishmuel zevan miggoy lakana dedahava bemar defarzela – bearba zuze, veavla leh chad zuza.

Rav kahana zevan miggoy mea veesrin chavyata bima, veavla leh chad zuza; amar leh: chazi, daalach ka samechna. ravina zevan dikla hu vegoy letzallacha, amar leh leshammaeh: kedem veayyti meikkaro, degoy minyayna yada.

Rav ashe hava kaazel beorcha, chaza shivsha degufena befardesa, utelu ba kittufe deinve. amar leh leshammaeh: zil chazi, i degoy ninhu – ayyti. i deyisrael ninhu – la ayyti li. shema hahu goy dahava yatev befardesa, amar leh: degoy shere?! amar leh: goy shakel deme, yisrael la shakel deme.
Gufa – amar shemuel: dina demalchuta dina. amar rava: tidda, dekatli dikle vegashri gishre – veavrinan alayyhu.
Amar leh abbaye: vedilma mishshum deiyyayush lehu minnayyhu marayyhu! amar leh: i la dina demalchuta dina, hechi miyyayashi?
Veha la ka avdi kidamar malka – malka amar: zilu uketulu mikkol bage, veinhu azlu vekatlu mechad baga!
Shelucha demalka – kemalka, vela tarach; veinhu afsid annafshayyhu – deibbei lehu (deinkut) [leminkat] mikkulleh bage, umishkal deme.
Amar rava: man demishtechach beve dare, para menata demalka. vehane mille shuttafa, aval arisa – arisuteh hu deka mappek.
Veamar rava: bar mata abbar mata miavat. vehane mille devorala ara ucheraga dehay shatta, aval shatta dachalef – hoil veippayyays malka, chalef.
Veamar rava: hane dedayyri dare betoch hattechum – asur likkach mehen. may tama? mishshum dimarva chevta demata bahadayyhu.
Chutz lattechum – muttar likkach mehem. amar ravina: im hayu bealim meraddefim acharehem, afillu chutz lattechum asur.

Machrez rava, veittema rav huna: desalkin leella udenachatin letatta – hay bar yisrael deyada sahaduta degoy (velo tevao minneh), veazel umashed leh bedina degoyim al yisrael chavreh – meshammetinan leh. may tama? deinhu mappeki mamona

a: Appumma dechad. vela amaran ella chad, aval bitre la. vechad name la amaran ella bedine demagista, aval be dauor – inhu name chad ammomta shadu leh.

Amar rav ashe: ki havena be rav huna, ibbaya lan: adam chashuv desamchi aleh keve tere – mappeki mamona appummeh, vela ibbei leh leashode; o dilma kevan deadam chashuv hu – la matze mishtemit lehu, umatze leashode? teku.

Amar rav ashe: hay bar yisrael dezabben leh ara legoy ammitzra devar yisrael chavreh – meshammetinan leh. may tama? i nema mishshum dina devar mitzra, vehaamar mar: zevan miggoy, vezabben legoy, lekka mishshum dina devar mitzra!
Ella deamrinan leh: arbat li arya ammitzray. meshammetinan leh ad dekabbel aleh kol unesa deate mechamateh.

Mishna natlu mochsin et chamoro venatnu lo chamor acher, natlu listim et kesuto venatnu lo kesut acheret – hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim mityayashin mehen. hammatztzil min hannahar o min haggayis o min hallistin, im nityayashu habbealim – hare ellu shello. vechen nechil shel devorim, im nityayashu – hare ellu shello.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben beroka: neemenet ishsha o katan lomar: mikkan yatza nechil ze. umehallech betoch sede chavero lehatztzil et nechilo, veim hizzik – meshallem ma shehizzik. aval lo yakotz et socho al menat litten et haddamim. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: af kotzetz venoten et haddamim.
Gemara tana: im natal – machzir livalim harishonim. kasavar: yeush kedi la kene, umeikkara beissura ata lideh.
Veikka deamri: im ba lehachezir – yachzir livalim rishonim. may tama? yeush kedi kane. mihu i amar: i efshi bemamon sheeno shelli – machzir livalim harishonim.
Hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim kulei. amar rav ashe: lo shanu ella listim goy, aval listim yisrael – la; savar: limchar naketna leh bedina.
Matkef la rav yosef: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! goyim, dedayyni begete – la miyyayash; yisrael, kevan deamri memar – miyyayash!
Ella i ittemar, assefa ittemar: hammatztzil min haggoyim umin hallistim, im nityayashu habbealim – in, setama – la.
Lo shanu ella goy, mishshum dedayyni begete; aval listim yisrael, kevan deamri memar – miyyayash.
Tenan hatam: orot shel baal habbayit, machshava metammeatan;
Veshel abbedan, en machshava metammeatan.
Shel gazlan, en machshava metammeatan; veshel gannav, machshava metammeatan.
Rabbi shimon omer: chilluf haddevarim – shel gazlan machshava metammeatan, shel gannav en machshava metammeatan; lefi shello nityayashu habbealim.
Amar ulla: machaloket bistam, aval beyadua – divre hakkol yeush kane. rabba amar: beyadua name machaloket.
Amar leh abbaye lerabba: la tiflog aleh deulla, ditnan bematnitin kevoteh – "lefi shello nityayashu habbealim". tama delo nityayashu habbealim, aval nityayashu habbealim – hare ellu shello!
Amar leh: anan, "lefi sheen yeush labbealim" matninan la.
Tenan: natlu mochsin chamoro kulei. manni?
I rabbanan – kashya gazlan, i rabbi shimon – kashya gannav!
Bishlama leulla, deamar: beyadua – kane; hacha name beyadua, vedivre hakkol.
Ella lerabba, deamar: beyadua name machloket; ha manni? la rabbanan vela rabbi shimon! belistim mezuyyayn, verabbi shimon hi.
I hachi, hayeynu gazlan! tere gavvne gazlan.
Ta shema: haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas – hekdeshan hekdesh, uterumatan teruma, umaserotan maaser.
Manni? i rabbanan – kashya gazlan, i rabbi shimon – kashya gannav!
Bishlama leulla, deamar beyadua kane; hacha name beyadua, vedivre hakkol hi. ella lerabba, deamar beyadua name machloket; ha manni? la rabbanan vela rabbi shimon!
Hacha name – belistim mezuyyayn, verabbi shimon hi. i hachi, hayeynu gazlan! tere gavvne gazlan.
Vei baet ema: ha matnita – rabbi hi; detanya, rabbi amar: gannav – kegazlan,
b: Vekayma lan kegazlan lerabbi shimon.
Gufa – rabbi omer, omer ani: gannav – kegazlan. ibbaya lehu: kegazlan derabbanan kaamar – vela kane; o dilma kegazlan derabbi shimon kaamar, ukene?
Ta shema: natlu mochsin chamoro vechulei.
Manni? i rabbanan, kashya gazlan! i rabbi shimon, kashya gannav!
I amrat bishlama rabbi – kegazlan derabbi shimon kaamar, vekane; ha manni – rabbi hi, mishshum hachi kane.
Ella i amrat kegazlan derabbanan kaamar, vela kane; ha manni? la rabbi vela rabbi shimon vela rabbanan!
Hacha bemay askinan? belistim mezuyyayn, verabbi shimon hi. i hachi, hayeynu gazlan! tere gavvne gazlan.
Ta shema: haggannav vehaggazlan vehaannas – hekdeshan hekdesh, uterumatan teruma, umaserotan maaser.
Manni? i rabbanan – kashya gazlan, i rabbi shimon – kashya gannav!
I amrat bishlama gannav kegazlan derabbi shimon kaamar, mishshum hachi kane; ella i amrat gannav kegazlan derabbanan, ha manni?
Belistim mezuyyayn, verabbi shimon hi. i hachi, hayeynu gazlan! tere gavvne gazlan.

Amar leh rav ashe lerabba: ta shema, dematne rabbi lerabbi shimon bereh: lo davar sheyyesh bo achrayut mammash; ella afillu para vechoresh bah, chamor umechammer acharav – chayyayvin lehachezir, mippene kevod avihen.
Tama mippene kevod avihen, ha lav kevod avihen – la; shema minna: rabbi – gazlan derabbi shimon kaamar! shema minna.
Vechen nechil shel devorim. may "vechen"?

Hachi kaamar: afillu nechil shel devorim, dekinyan derabbanan hu. salka datach amena: hay, kevan derabbanan bealma hu dekane leh – afillu setama name miyyayash; ka mashma lan: im nityayashu habbealim – en, i la – la.
Amar rabbi yochanan ben beroka: neemenet ishsha vekatan kulei.
Ishsha vekatan bene edut ninhu? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayu bealim meraddefin acharehem, veishsha vekatan massichin lefi tummam, veomer: mikkan yatza nechil ze.
Amar rav ashe: en mesiach lefi tummo kasher – ella leedut ishsha bilvad.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vela? vahare nechil shel devorim – mesiach lefi tummo hu! shane nechil shel devorim, dekinyan derabbanan hu.

Udeorayyta la? vehaamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: maase beadam echad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo, veomer: "zechurani kesheani tinok, umurekavani al ketefo shel abba, vehotziuni mibbet hassefer, vehifshituni et kuttonti, vehitbiluni leechol bitruma laerev".
Verabbi chanina mesayyem ba hachi: "vachaveray bedelin mimmenni, vehayu korin oti: yochanan ochel challot". veheelahu rabbi lakkehunna al piv!
Bitruma derabbanan.

Veakkatti, deorayyta la? veha ki ata rav dimi amar rav chana kartigana, veamri la rav acha kartigana mishtae: maase ba lifne rabbi yehoshua ben levi, veamri la maase ba lifne rabbi, betinok echad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo, veamar: "ani veimmi nishbinu leven haggoyim, yatzati lishov mayim – dati al immi, lilkot etzim – dati al immi".
Vehissiah rabbi al piv lakkehunna!
Bishvuya hekellu.

Aval lo yakotz et socho [vechulei]. tanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: tenay bet din hu, sheyyehe yored letoch sade shel chavero vekotzetz socho shel chavero, lehatztzil et nechilo. venotel deme socho mittoch nechilo shel chavero.

Utenay bet din hu, sheyyehe shofech yeno umatztzil et duveshano shel chavero, venotel deme yeno mittoch duveshano shel chavero. utenay bet din hu, sheyyehe mefarek et etzav vetoen pishtano shel chavero, venotel deme etzav mittoch pishtano shel chavero. sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz.
Mishna hammakkir kelav usefarav beyad acher, veyatza lo shem geneva bair – yishshava lo lokeach kamma natan, veyittol. veim lav – lav kol hemennu, sheani omer: mecharan leacher, ulekachan ze hemennu.
Gemara vechi yatza lo shem geneva bair – may have? lechush dilma zabbeninhu, vehu nihu ka mappek shema!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kegon shebbau bene adam betoch beto, veamad vehifgin ballayla, veamar: nignevu chelayi. kol shekken illa matza!

Rav kahana mesayyem ba mishshemeh derav: kegon shehayta machteret chatura betoch beto, uvene adam shellanu betoch beto – yatzu, veanburekraot shel kelim al kitfehem, vehakkol omrim: "nignevu kelav shel peloni".
Vedilma kelim havo, sefarim la havo! amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kegon dekaamri name sefarim.
Velechush dilma zutere, veka taen ravreve! amar rabbi yose bar chanina, dekaamri: sefer peloni ufeloni.
Vedilma havo attike, veka taen chadte! amar rav, kegon deamri: "hallalu kelav shel peloni, hallalu sefarav shel peloni".
Umi amar rav hachi? vehaamar rav: ba bammachteret, venatal kelim veyatza – patur. may tama? bidme kenanhu!
Hane mille diknanhu – beva bammachteret, demeikkara mesar nafsheh liktala; aval hane, kevan dela mesaru nafshayyhu liktala – la.
Amar rava: lo shanu ella baal habbayit heasuy limkor kelav, aval baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor kelav –

a: La tzarich leahdore aleh kulle hay.
Vedilma itzterich leh zuze, vezabben! amar rav ashe: hare yatza lo shem geneva bair.
Ittemar: ganav umachar, veachar kach hukkar haggannav – rav mishshemeh derabbi chiyyay amar: haddin im harishon. rabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yannay amar: haddin im hashsheni.
Amar rav yosef: la peligi; kan lifne yeush – haddin im hashsheni, kan leachar yeush – haddin im harishon.
Vetarvayyhu it lehu derav chisda.

Amar leh abbaye: vela peligi? ha mattenot kehunna kelifne yeush dame, ufeligi! ditnan, amar lo: "mechor li meeha shel para", vehayu bahen mattanot – notnan lechohen, veeno menakke lo min haddamim. lakach hemennu bemishkal – notno lechohen, umenakke lo min haddamim.
Veamar rav: lo shanu ella sheshshakal leatzmo, aval shakal lo hattabbach – haddin im hattabbach.
Ema: af din im hattabbach. mahu detema: en mattenot kehunna nigzalot, ka mashma lan.
Uleabbaye deamar peligi, bemay peligi? bidrav chisda.
Rav zevid amar: kegon shennityayashu habbealim beyad lokeach, velo nityayashu beyad gannav.
Uveha peligi – mar savar: yeush veachar kach shinnuy reshut – kane, shinnuy reshut veachar kach yeush – la kane; umar savar: la shena.
Rav pappa amar: biglima – dechulle alma la peligi dehadar lemareh, vehacha beasu bo takkanat hashshuk kamippalgi –

Rav mishshemeh derabbi chiyyay amar haddin im harishon – dina delokeach delishkol zuze miggannav, velo asu bo takkanat hashshuk. verabbi yochanan mishshum derabbi yannay amar haddin im hashsheni – dina delokeach delishkol mibbaal habbayit, veasu bo takkanat hashshuk.
Vesavar rav lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk? veha rav huna talmideh derav hava, vechanan bisha genav gelima vezabbena. ata lekammeh derav huna, amar leh lehahu gavra: zil sheri avitach!
Shane chanan bisha, kevan delekka leishtallome minneh – kelo hukkar dame.
Amar rava: im gannav mefuresam hu, lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk. veha chanan bisha, dimfuresam hava, veasu bo takkanat hashshuk! nehi dimfuresam levishuta, lignivuta la mefuresam.
Ittemar: ganav ufara bechovo, ganav ufara behekkefo – lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk, deamri: la addata dehanhu yehavt leh midde.
Mashkanta; shave matan bima – asu bo takkanat hashshuk. shave beshave – ammemar amar: lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk, mar zutera amar: asu bo takkanat hashshuk.
Vehilcheta: asu bo takkanat hashshuk.
Zevina; shave beshave – asu bo takkanat hashshuk. shave mea bematan – rav sheshet amar: lo asu bo takkanat hashshuk, rava amar: asu bo takkanat hashshuk.
Vehilcheta: bechullehu asu bo takkanat hashshuk, levar migganav ufara bechovo, ganav ufara behekkefo.
Avimi bar nazi chamu deravina hava massek behahu gavra arbea zuze. genav gelima etya nihaleh, ozfeh arbea zuze acharine. lesof hukkar haggannav. ata lekammeh deravina,
Amar: kammae – ganav ufara bechovo, vela bae lemittav leh vela midde; hanach arbea zuze acharine – shekol zuzach, v[a]hedar gelime[].

Matkef la rav kohen: vedilma gelima – behane zuze kammae yahava nihaleh, "ganav ufara bechovo, ganav ufara behekkefo"; vearbea zuze batrae – hemone hemneh, ki hechi dehemneh meikkara! iggalgal milleta, meta lekammeh derabbi avahu, amar: hilcheta kerav kohen.

Narshaa genav sifra, zabbeneh lefappunaa bitmanan zuze. azal pappunaa, zabbeneh levar machozaa bima veesrin zuze. lesof hukkar haggannav. amar abbaye: lezil mare desifra veyahev leh levar machoza temanan zuze veshakel sifreh, veazel bar machozaa veshakel arbein mippappunaa.
Matkef la rava: hasheta lokeach miggannav – asu bo takkanat hashshuk, lokeach millokeach mibbaya?
Ella amar rava: lezil mareh desifra veyahev leh levar machozaa mea veesrin zuze veshakel sifreh, velezil mare[] desifra velishkol arbein mippappunaa, utemanan minnarshaa.
Mishna ze ba bechavito shel yayin veze ba bechaddo shel devash, nisdeka chavit shel devash, veshafach ze et yeno vehitztzil et haddevash letocho –
b: En lo ella secharo. veim amar: "atztzil et shellecha, veatta noten li deme shelli" – chayyayv litten lo.

Shataf nachal chamoro vachamor chavero, shello yafe mane veshel chavero matayim, vehinniach ze et shello vehitztzil et shel chavero – en lo ella secharo. veim amar lo: "ani atztzil et shellecha, veatta noten li et shelli" – chayyayv litten lo.

Gemara veammay? lema leh: mehefkera ka zachena! mi la tanya: hare shehaya taun kadde yayin vechadde shemen, veraa shehen mishtabberot, lo yomar: "hare ze teruma umaaser al perot sheyyesh li betoch beti", veim amar – lo amar kelum?
Kidamar rabbi yirmeya: kesheekel bet habbad karuch aleha; hachi name, kesheekel bet habbad karuch aleha.
Veim amar – lo amar kelum? vehatanya: mi shebba badderech umaot beyado veannas kenegdo, lo yomar: "hare perot sheyyesh li betoch beti mechullalim al maot hallalu", veim amar – devarav kayyaymin!
Hacha bemay askinan – besheyyachol lehatztzil. i besheyyachol lehatztzil, lechattechilla ammay lo yomar? besheyyachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak.

Vechol hecha deikka hefseda, lechattechilla lo yomar? vehatanya: hare shehayu lo eser chaviyyot shel tevel tame, veraa achat mehen shennishbera o shennitgalleta, omer: "hare hi terumat maaser al tesha chavroteha". uveshemen lo yaase ken, mippene hefsed kohen!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: kesheekel bet habbad karuch aleha. bishlama shennishbera – chazya, ella nitgalleta – lemay chazya?

Vechi tema chazya lezilluf, vehatanya: mayim shennitgallu – hare ze lo yishpechem birshut harabbim; velo yegabbel bahen et hattit; velo yerabbetz bahen et habbayit; velo yashke mehem et behemto, velo behemat chavero!

Deabbar lah bimsannenet, kerabbi nechemya – detanya: mesannenet, yesh bah mishshum gilluy. amar rabbi nechemya: ematay – bizman shehattachtona megulla, aval bizman shehattachtona mechussa – af al pi shehaelyona megulla, en bah mishshum gilluy; lefi sheeres shel nachash dome lisfog, vetzaf veomed bimkomo.
Lav ittemar ala, amar rabbi simon amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo shanu ella shello terako, aval terako – asur?
Hatam name, efshar demannach midde appumma dechavita, (deshafe) [veshafe] leh.
Verabbi nechemya – (mittame attame) mi tarminan?

Vehatanya: tormin min hattame al hattame, umin hattahor al hattahor, umin hattahor al hattame; aval lo min hattame al hattahor. rabbi nechemya omer: af min hattame al hattame lo hittiru litrom, ella beshel demay! hacha name beshel demay.

Amar mar: uveshemen lo yaase ken, mippene hefsed kohen. may shena shemen – derauy lehadelik? yayin name rauy lezilluf! vechi tema zilluf lav milleta hi, vehaamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyyay: shotin millog besela, umezallefin millog bishtayim!
Hacha bemay askinan – bechadash. veha rauy leyashsheno! ate beh lide takkala.
Shemen name ate beh lide takkala! demannach [leh] bichli maus. yayin name mannach leh bichli maus! hasheta lezilluf ka bae leh, bichli maus ka mannach leh?!
Vetakkala atzmah tannae hi – detanya: chavit shel yayin shel teruma, shennitmet – bet shammay omrim:

a: Tishshafech hakkol, uvet hillel omrim: tease zilluf. amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose: ani achria; babbayit – tease zilluf, uvassade – tishshafech hakkol.
Ikka deamri: beyashan – tease zilluf, uvechadash – tishshafech hakkol. amru lo: en hacheraa shelishit machraat.
Im amar lo: "atztzil et shellecha vechulei". ammay? venema leh: "meshatte ani bach"!

Mi la tanya: hare shehaya boreach mibbet haasurin vehayta maboret lefanav, amar lo: "tol dinar, vehaavireni" – en lo ella secharo. alma amar leh: "meshatte ani bach"; hacha name, lema leh: "meshatte ani bach"!
Ha la dame ella lesefa – veim amar lo: "tol dinar ze bischarcha, vehaavireni" – noten lo secharo mishshalem.
May shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rame bar chama: betzayyayd hashshole dagim min hayyam, veamar leh: afsedtani kevore bezuza.

Shataf nahar chamoro vachamor chavero, shello yafe mane vechulei. utzericha; dei ashmeinan kammayyta, hatam hu dechi peresh yahev leh deme kulleh, mishshum divyadayim ka fased; aval hacha demimmela, nema: en lo ella secharo.
Vei ashmeinan sefa, hacha hu devistama en lo ella secharo, mishshum demimmela; aval hatam, divyadayim, ema afillu bistama yahev leh deme kulle; tzericha.
Bea minneh rav kahana merav: yarad lehatztzil, veala shello meelav, mahu? amar leh: mishshemayya rechimu aleh.

Ki ha derav safra hava ka azel bishyayrta, lavvinhu hahu ari. kol lelya ka (shaddar) [shadu] leh chamara dechad minnayyhu, veka achel. ki meta zimneh derav safra, (shaddar) [sheda] leh chamare vela achleh. kedem rav safra uzecha beh.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: lema leh lemizke beh? nehi dechi afkereh – addata dearya afkereh, addata dechulle alma la afkereh! amar leh: rav safra leravvcha demilleta hu daavad.
Bea minneh rav merabbi: yarad lehatztzil velo hitztzil, mahu? amar lo: vezo sheela, en lo ella secharo.
Etiveh: hassocher et happoel
b: Lehavi keruv veduremaskanin lachole, vehalach umetzao shemmet o shehivri – noten lo secharo mishshalem!
Amar leh: mi dame?! hatam aved shaliach shelichuteh, hacha la aved shaliach shelichuteh.
Tanu rabbanan: sheyayra shehayta mehallechet bammidbar, veamad aleha gayis letorfah – mechashshevin lefi mamon, veen mechashshevin lefi nefashot.
Veim sachru tayyayr haholech lifnehem – mechashshevin af lefi nefashot; velo yeshannu mimminhag hachammarin.
Rashshain hachammarin lehatenot shekkol mi sheyyovad lo chamoro naamid lo chamor acher. bechuseya – en maamidin, shello bechuseya – maamidin lo. veim amar: "tenu li, vaani eshmor" – en shomin lo.
Peshita! la tzericha, deit leh chamara acharina. mahu detema: ha ka meynattar leh; ka mashma lan – shane netiruta dechad minnetiruta deve tere.
Tanu rabbanan: sefina shehayta mehallechet bayyam; amad aleha nachshol letovah, vehekellu mimmassaah – mechashshevin lefi massooy, veen mechashshevin lefi mamon; velo yeshannu mimminhag hassappanim.

Verashshain hassappanim lehatenot, shekkol mi sheavda lo sefina naamid lo sefina acheret. avda lo bechuseya – en maamidin, shello bechuseya – maamidin lo. vei perash lemakom sheen hassefinot holchin – en maamidin.
Peshita! la tzericha, divnisan merachaki chad ashla, uvetishri merachaki tere ashle, veka azel beyome nisan limkom tishre; mahu detema: davvsheh naket veazel, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: sheyayra shehayta mehallechet bammidbar veamad gayis uterafah, veamad echad mehen vehitztzil – hitztzil laemtza. veim amar: "ani atztzil leatzmi" – hitztzil leatzmo.
Hechi dame? i deyachol lehatztzil, afillu sefa name laemtza! vei delo yachol lehatztzil, afillu resha name leatzmo!
Amar rame bar chama: hacha beshuttafin askinan, uchegon ze – shuttaf cholek shello ledaat chavero; amar – paleg, la amar – la paleg.
Rava amar: hacha befoalin askinan, ucherav – deamar rav: poel yachol lachazor bo afillu bachatzi hayyom.
Vechamma dela hadar beh – kevirshuteh devaal habbayit dame, vechi hadar beh – tama acharina hu, dichtiv: "ki li vene yisrael avadim" – velo avadim laavadim.
Rav ashe amar: kesheyyachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak. galli dateh – leatzmo, la galli dateh – laemtza.
Mishna haggozel sade mechavero unetaluha massikin, im makkat medina hi – omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha"; im mechamat haggazlan – chayyayv lehaamid lo sade acher.
Gemara amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: man detane "massikin" – la mishtabbash, uman detane "matztzikin" – la mishtabbash. man detane "matztzikin" la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "bematzor uvematzok".
Uman detane "massikin" la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "yeyaresh hatztzelatzal" – umetargeminan: yachseninneh sakkaa.
Im mechamat haggazlan – chayyayv. hechi dame? illema deansuha leara dideh vela anasu kulle arata, ha meresha shamat minna: im makkat medina hi kulei, i la – la!
La tzericha, deachvay achvoye. lishshana acharina: hacha bemay askinan – kegon deansu goyim, (veamri) [veachvi] leh achvoye arateh, veachvi hahiv bahadayyhu.

Hahu gavra deachvi akkarya dechitte deve resh galuta. ata lekammeh derav nachman, chayyeyveh rav nachman leshallome. yatev rav yosef achoreh derav huna bar chiyyay, veyatev rav huna bar chiyyay kammeh derav nachman, amar leh rav huna bar chiyyay lerav nachman: dina o kenasa?
Amar leh: matnitin hi, ditnan: im mechamat haggazlan – chayyayv lehaamid lo sade; veokimna deachvi achvoye. batar dinfak, amar leh rav yosef lerav huna bar chiyyay: may nafka lach minneh

a: I dina i kenasa? amar leh: i dina – gamrinan minneh, i kenasa – la gamrinan minneh.
Umena temra demikkenasa la gamrinan? detanya, barishona hayu omrim: hametamme vehamenassech; chazru lomar: af hamedammea.
Chazru – in, lo chazru – la; may tama? lav mishshum diknasa hu, ukenasa la gamrinan minneh?
La; meikkara savri: lehefsed merubbe chashshu, lehefsed muat lo chashshu; ulevassof savri: lehefsed muat name chashshu.
Ini?! veha tane avu derabbi avin, barishona hayu omrim: hametamme vehamedammea; chazru lomar: af hamenassech. chazru – in, lo chazru – la!
May tama? lav mishshum dela gamrinan mikkenasa?
La; meikkara savri kerabbi avin, ulevassof savri kerabbi yirmeya.
Meikkara savri kerabbi avin – deamar rabbi avin: zarak chetz mittechillat arba lesof arba, vekara shirain bahalichato – patur; shehare akira tzorech hannacha hi, umitchayyev benafsho.
