Ulevassof savri kerabbi yirmeya – deamar rabbi yirmeya: mishsheat hagebaha kanyeh, ichayyayv leh mamon; mitchayyev benafsho la have ad sheat nissuch.
Rav huna bar yehuda ikkela leve evyone. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: kelum maase ba lidach? amar leh: yisrael sheanasuhu goyim vehera mamon chavero ba leyadi, vechiyyayvtiv.
Amar leh: ahdar ovada lemareh, detanya: yisrael sheanasuhu goyim vehera mamon chavero – patur, veim natal venatan bayyad – chayyayv!
Amar rabba: im hera meatzmo, kenasa venatan bayyad dame.
Hahu gavra daanasuhu goyim, veachvi achamra derav mari bereh derav pinchas bereh derav chisda. amaru leh: "deri veamti bahadan", dera veamti bahadayyhu. ata lekammeh derav ashe, patrinneh.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe, vehatanya: im nasa venatan bayyad – chayyayv! amar lehu: hane mille hecha dela okmeh illaveh meikkara, aval hecha deokmeh illaveh meikkara – mikle kalyeh.
Etiveh rabbi avahu lerav ashe: amar lo annas "hoshet li pekia amir ze, o eshkol anavim ze", vehoshit lo – chayyayv! hacha bemay askinan – kegon dekae bitre evre nahara.
Dayka name, dekatane "hoshet" vela tane "ten", shema minna.

Hahu shuta dahavo minnetzu ala be tere. hay amar: didi hu, vehay amar: didi hu. azal chad minnayyhu umasra lefarhag[ba]na demalka. amar abbaye, yachol lomar: ana ki mesari – didi mesari. amar leh rava: vechol keminneh?! ella amar rava: meshammetinan leh ad demayyte leh vekae bedina.
Hahu gavra dahava bae achvoye attivna dechavreh. ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: "la tachve vela tachve!" amar leh: "machvena umachvena!" yatev rav kahana kammeh derav, shamteh lekoeh minneh.

Kare rav illaveh: "banayich ullefu shachvu berosh kol chutzot keto michmar"; ma to ze, kevan shennafal bemichmar – en merachamin alav; af mamon shel yisrael, kevan shennafal beyad goyim – en merachamin alav.

Amar leh rav: "kahana, ad haiddana havo parsae – dela kafdi ashshefichut damim, vehasheta ikka yavvnae – dekafdu ashshefichut damim, veamri 'mardin, mardin. kum sak leara deyisrael, vekabbel alach dela takshe lerabbi yochanan sheva shenin".

Azayl, ashkecheh leresh lakish deyatev veka mesayyem metivta deyoma lerabbanan. amar lehu: resh lakish hecha? amaru leh: ammay? amar lehu: hay kusheya vehay kusheya, vehay peruka vehay peruka. amaru leh leresh lakish. azal resh lakish amar leh lerabbi yochanan: "ari ala mibbavel, leayyen mar bimtivta delimchar".

Limchar otvu bedara kamma kammeh derabbi yochanan. amar shemateta – vela akshi, shemateta – vela akshi; anchateh achore sheva dare, ad deotveh bedara batra. amar leh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish: "ari sheamarta – naasa shual!"
Amar: yehe raava dehane sheva dare lihvo chilluf sheva shenin daamar li rav. kam akkareh, amar leh: "nehdar mar beresha". amar shemateta, veakshi. okmeh bedara kamma. amar shemateta, veakshi.

Rabbi yochanan hava yatev ashsheva bistarke, shalfi leh chada bistarka mittuteh. amar shemateta – veakshi leh, ad deshalfi leh kullehu bistarke mittuteh, ad deyatev al ara. rabbi yochanan gavra sava hava umesarchi gevineh, amar lehu: dallo li enay veechzeyeh. dallo leh bemachchalta dechaspa.

Chaza difrita sifvoteh, sevar achoche kamchayyech beh. chalash dateh, venach nafsheh. limchar amar lehu rabbi yochanan lerabbanan: chazetu levavlaa hechi aved? amaru leh: darkeh hachi. al legabbe mearta, chaza dahava
b: Hadra leh achna. amar leh: "achna, achna, petach pummaych veyikkanes harav etzel talmid", vela petach. "yikkanes chaver etzel chaver", vela petach. "yikkanes talmid etzel harav", petach leh. bea rachame veokmeh.

Amar leh: "i hava yadana dedarkeh demar hachi, la chalsha dati; hasheta lete mar bahadan". amar leh: "i matzet lemive rachame detu la shachevna – azelna, vei la – la azelna, hoil vachalef shata, chalef".
Tayyeyreh okmeh. shayyleh kol sefeka dahava leh, ufashtinhu nihaleh. hayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan: "dilchon amari; dilhon hi".
Hahu deachvi ammetachsa derabbi abba. yetev rabbi avahu verabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi yitzchak nappacha, veyatev rabbi ila gabbayyhu.
Sevur lechayyoveh meha ditnan: dan et haddin – zikka et hachayyayv vechiyyev et hazzakkay, timme et hattahor vetiher et hattame – ma sheasa asuy, vishallem mibbeto.
Amar lehu rabbi ila, hachi amar rav: vehu shennasa venatan bayyad. amri leh: zil legabbe derabbi shimon ben elyakim verabbi elazar ben pedat, dedayyni dina digrame.
Azal legabbayyhu, chayyeyveh mimmatnitin – im mechamat haggazlan, chayyayv lehaamid lo sade acher; veokimna deachvi achvoye.

Hahu gavra dahava mippekid leh kasa dechaspa. seliku gannave illaveh, shakla yahava lehu. ata lekammeh derabba, patreh. amar leh abbaye: hay matztzil atzmo bemamon chavero hu! ella amar rav ashe: chazenan; i inish amid hu – addata dideh ato, vei la – addata dechaspa ato.

Hahu gavra dahava mippekid gabbeh arneka defidyon shevuyim. seliku gannave illaveh, shakla yahava nihalayyhu. ata lekammeh derava, patreh. amar leh abbaye: veha matztzil atzmo bemamon chavero hu! amar leh: en lecha pidyon shevuyim gadol mizze.

Hahu gavra deakdem veassek chamara lemabbara, kamme disliku inashe bemabbara. bae leatboe, ata hahu gavra, melach leh lachamara dehahu gavra veshadyeh lenahara, uteva. ata lekammeh derabba, patreh. amar leh abbaye: veha matztzil atzmo bemamon chavero hu! amar leh: hay – meikkara rodef hava.
Rabba letameh, deamar rabba: rodef shehaya rodef achar chavero lehorgo, veshibber et hakkelim, ben shel nirdof ben shel kol adam – patur, shehare mitchayyev benafsho.
Venirdof sheshshibber et hakkelim shel rodef – patur, shello yehe mamono chaviv alav miggufo. aval shel kol adam – chayyayv, deasur lehatztzil atzmo bemamon chavero.

Verodef shehaya rodef achar rodef lehatztzil, veshibber kelim, ben shel nirdof ben shel kol adam – patur. velo min haddin, ella sheim i atta omer ken – en lecha adam shemmatztzil et chavero min harodef.
Mishna shetafah nahar, omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".
Gemara tanu rabbanan: haggozel sade mechavero ushetafah nahar – chayyayv lehaamid lo sade acher, divre rabbi elazar. vachachamim omrim, omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha".
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi elazar daresh ribbuye umiute; "vechichesh baamito" – (ribbuy) [ribba], "befikkadon" – miet, "kol asher yishshava alav lashsheker" – chazar veribba.
Ribba umiet veribba – ribba hakkol; umay rabbi? rabbi kol mille.
Umay miet? miet shetarot.
Verabbanan darshi kelale uferate; "vechichesh" – kalal, "befikkadon" – parat, "o mikkol" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella cheen happerat;

Ma happerat – davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon, af kol davar hammittaltel vegufo mamon. yatzu karkaot – sheen mittaltelin; yatzu avadim – shehukkeshu lekarkaot; yatzu shetarot – sheaf al pi shemmittaltelin, en gufan mamon.
Vehadtanya: haggozel et happara ushetafah nahar – chayyayv lehaamid lo para, divre rabbi elazar. vachachamim omrim, omer lo: "hare shellecha lefanecha". hatam bemay kamippalgi?
Amar rav pappa: hatam bemay askinan – kegon sheggazal sade mechavero vehayta

a: Para revutza bo, ushetafah nahar; derabbi elazar letameh, verabbanan letamayyhu.
Mishna haggozel et chavero o shehilva hemennu o shehifkid lo, bayyishshuv – lo yachazir lo bammidbar. al menat latzet bammidbar – yachazir lo bammidbar.

Gemara ureminhu: milva mishtallemet bechol makom, aveda ufikkadon en mishtallemin ella bimkoman! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: milva nittena littava bechol makom, aveda ufikkadon lo nittenu littava ella bimkoman.

Al menat latzet bammidbar. peshita! la tzericha, daamar leh: "leheve hay pikkadon gabbach, daana lemidbar nafekna", vaamar leh ihu: "ana lemidbar name baena lemippak. i baena leahdorinhu lach, hatam mahdarna lach".

Mishna haomer lachavero: "gezalticha"; "hilvitani"; "hifkadta etzli, veeni yodea im hechzarti lach im lo hechzarti lach" – chayyayv leshallem. aval im amar lo: "eni yodea im gezalticha"; "im hilvitani"; "im hifkadta etzli" – patur milleshallem.
Gemara ittemar: "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer: "eni yodea" – rav huna verav yehuda amri: chayyayv, verav nachman verabbi yochanan amri: patur.
Rav huna verav yehuda amri chayyayv – bari veshemma, bari adif. rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri patur – oki mamona bechezkat mareh.
Tenan, aval im amar lo: "eni yodea im hilvitani" – patur. hechi dame? illema dela ka tava leh – resha name dela ka tava leh; ammay chayyayv? ella dekatava leh, vekatane sefa: patur milleshallem!
La; leolam dela ka tava leh, veresha – beva latzet yede shamayim.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: haomer lachavero "mane li beyadcha", vehalla omer "eni yodea" – chayyayv, beva latzet yede shamayim.
Mishna haggonev tale min haeder vehechziro, umet o nignav – chayyayv beachrayuto. lo yadu bealim lo bignevato velo bachazirato, umanu et hatztzon ushelema hi – patur.
Gemara amar rav: ledaat – tzarich daat. shello ledaat – minyan poter. vechi katane "umanu et hatztzon vehi shelema" – assefa.
Ushemuel amar: ben ledaat ben shello ledaat – minyan poter, vechi katane: "umanu vehi shelema, patur" – akkulla.
Verabbi yochanan omer: ledaat – minyan poter, shello ledaat – afillu minyan name la tzerich. vechi katane: "umanu et hatztzon vehi shelema" – aresha.
Rav chisda amar: ledaat – minyan poter, shello ledaat – tzarich daat. vechi katane: "umanu et hatztzon vehi shelema" – aresha.
Amar rava:
b: May tama derav chisda? hoil veanketa nigre barayayta.
Umi amar rava hachi? vehaamar rava: hay man dechazyeh lechavreh deagba immera meedra dideh, urema beh kala veshadyeh, vela yeda i hadara i la hadara, umet o nignav – chayyayv beachrayuto.
May, lav af al gav dimni? la, dela meni.
Umi amar rav hachi? vehaamar rav: hechziro leeder shebbammidbar – yatza! amar rav chanan bar abba: mode rav birkoata.
Lema ketannae: haggonev tale min haeder, vesela min hakkis – limkom shegganav yachazir, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: tzarich daat bealim.
Savruha, dechulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak – deamar rabbi yitzchak: adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa. may, lav besela ledaat – uviflugeta derav ushemuel?
La; betale shello ledaat, uviflugeta derav chisda verabbi yochanan.

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: beshomer shegganav mershut bealim – kulle alma la peligi, kidrav chisda; vehacha beshomer shegganav mershuto, sheyyachazir limkom shegganav kamippalgi – rabbi akiva savar: kalta lo shemirato, verabbi yishmael savar: lo kalta lo shemirato.
Lema minyan poter – tannae hi? detanya: haggozel et chavero, vehivlia lo becheshbon – tane chada: yatza, vetanya iddach: lo yatza.

Savruha, dechulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak, deamar: adam asuy lemashmesh bechiso bechol shaa veshaa. may, lav beha kamippalgi – deman deamar yatza, savar: minyan poter; uman deamar lo yatza, savar: minyan eno poter?
Amri: i sevira lan kerabbi yitzchak – kulle alma la peligi deminyan poter; ella bidrabbi yitzchak kamippalgi – mar it leh derabbi yitzchak, umar let leh derabbi yitzchak.
Vei baet ema: dechulle alma it lehu derabbi yitzchak; vela kashya, ha dimni urema leh bechiseh, veha dimni urema lideh.
Veibbaet ema: idde veidde dimni urema bechiseh; ha deit leh zuze acharine bechiseh, ha delet leh zuze acharine bechiseh.
Mishna en lokchin min haroim – tzemer vechalav ugedayim, velo mishshomre ferot – etzim uferot.
Aval lokchin min hannashim – kele tzemer bihuda, uchele fishtan baggalil, vaagalim bashsharon. vechullan sheamru lehatemin – asur. velokchin betzim vetarnegolin mikkol makom.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: en lokchin min haroim lo izzim velo gedayim velo gizzin velo telushin shel tzemer, aval lokchin mehen tefurin – mippene shehen shellahen. velokchin mehen chalav ugevina bammidbar, velo bayyishshuv.
Velokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon, arba vechamesh gizzin; aval lo shete tzon velo shete gizzin.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bayyaytot lokchin mehen, midbariyyot en lokchin mehen. kelalo shel davar: kol sheharoe mocher uvaal habbayit margish bo – lokchin mehen, en margish bo – en lokchin mehen.

Amar mar: lokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon, arba vechamesh gizzin. hasheta yesh lomar arba zavninan, chamesh mibbaya? amar rav chisda: arba mittoch chamesh. veikka deamri, amar rav chisda: arba meeder katan, vechamesh meeder gadol.
Ha gufa kashya – amrat: "arba vechamesh tzon, arba vechamesh gizzin", arba vechamesh – in, aval shalosh – la; ema sefa: "aval lo shete tzon" – ha shalosh zavninan!
La kashya; ha bevaryayta, ha bichchishata.
Rabbi yehuda omer: bayyaytot lokchin mehen, midbariyyot en lokchin mehen kulei. ibbaya lehu: rabbi yehuda – aresha kae, ulechumera; o dilma assefa kae, ulekulla?

Aresha kae, ulechumera – deamar: "lokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon", hane mille bayyaytot, aval midbariyyot – afillu arba vechamesh lo; o dilma assefa kae, ulekulla – deamar: "aval lo shete tzon velo shete gizzin", hane mille midbariyyot, aval bayyaytot – shetayim name lokchin?
Ta shema: detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: lokchin bayyaytot mehen, veen lokchin mehen midbariyyot. uvechol makom lokchin mehen arba vechamesh tzon.

a: Middeamar "bechol makom", shema minna assefa kae, ulekulla! shema minna.

Velo mishshomre ferot kulei. rava zaven shevishata mearisa. amar leh abbaye, veha tenan: velo mishshomre ferot – etzim uferot! amar leh: hane mille beshomer, delet leh begufa deara midde; aval aris, deit leh begavvevy – ema middenafsheh ka mezabben.

Tanu rabbanan: shomre ferot – lokchin mehen keshehen yoshvin umochrin, vehassallin lifnehem, veturetane lifnehem. vechullan sheamru: "hatemen" – asur. lokchin mehen mippetach hagginna, aval lo meachore hagginna.
Ittemar: gazlan, meemat muttar liknot hemennu? rav amar: ad shettehe rov mishshello, ushemuel amar: afillu miut shello.
Ori leh rav yehuda leadda dayyayla kedivre haomer afillu miut shello.
Mamon masor – rav huna verav yehuda; chad amar: muttar leabbedo bayyad, vechad amar: asur leabbedo bayyad.
Man deamar muttar leabbedo bayyad – lo yehe mamono chamur miggufo. uman deamar asur leabbedo – dilma have leh zara mealleya, uchetiv: "yachin rasha vetzaddik yilbash".
Rav chisda hava leh hahu arisa, dahava takel veyahev takel veshakel. sallekeh, kera annafsheh: "vetzafun latztzaddik chel chote".
"Ki ma tikvat chanef ki yivtza, ki yeshel eloah nafsho" – rav huna verav chisda; chad amar: nafsho denigzal, vechad amar: nafsho shel gazlan.

Man deamar nafsho shel nigzal – dichtiv: "ken orchot kol botzea batza, et nefesh bealav yikkach". man deamar nafsho shel gazlan – dichtiv: "al tigzol dal ki dal hu, veal tedakke ani vashshaar. ki Adonai yariv rivam, vekava et kovehem nafesh".
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "nefesh bealav yikkach"! may "bealav" – bealav dehashta.
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "vekava et kovehem nafesh"! "ma taam" kaamar – ma taam "vekava et kovehem"? mishshum dekavi nefesh.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol haggozel et chavero shave peruta – keillu notel nishmato mimmennu, shenneemar: "ken orchot kol botzea batza, et nefesh bealav yikkach"; veomer: "veachal ketzircha velachmecha, banecha uvenotecha".
Veomer: "mechamas bene yehuda, asher shafchu dam naki beartzam"; veomer: "el shaul veel bet haddamim, al asher hemit et haggivonim".
May "veomer"? vechi tema nefesh dideh, aval nefesh banav uvenotav la – ta shema: "besar banav uvenotav".
Vechi tema, hane mille hecha dela yahev deme, aval hecha deyahev deme la – ta shema: "mechamas bene yehuda, asher shafchu dam naki (beartzechem) [beartzam]".

Vechi tema, hane mille hecha dekaaved beyadayim, aval gerama la – ta shema: "el shaul veel bet haddamim, [al] asher hemit et haggivonim"; vechi hechan matzinu sheharag shaul et haggivonim? ella mittoch sheharag nov ir hakkohanim shehayu maspikin lahen mayim umazon, maale alav hakkatuv keillu haragan.

Aval lokchin min hannashim. tanu rabbanan: lokchin min hannashim kele tzemer bihuda uchele fishtan baggalil, aval lo yenot ushemanim uselatot. velo min haavadim, velo min hattinokot. abba shaul omer: mocheret ishsha bearbaa vachamishsha dinari[yn], kede laasot kippa leroshah. vechullan sheamru lehatemin – asur.
Gabbae tzedaka lokchin mehen davar muat, aval lo davar merubbe.

Vehabbaddadin – lokchin mehen zetim bemidda, veshemen bemidda. aval lo zetim bemuat veshemen bemuat. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lokchin minnashim zetim bemuat baggalil haelyon, sheppeamim adam bosh limkor al petach beto, venoten leishto umocheret.

Ravina ikkela leve machoza, ato neshe deve machoza remo kammeh kavle veshere, kabbel minnayyhu. amar leh rabba tosfaa leravina, vehatanya: gabbae tzedaka mekabbelin mehen davar muat, aval lo davar merubbe! amar leh: hane, livne machoza davar muat ninhu.

Mishna mochin shehakkoves motzi – hare ellu shello, vehassorek motzi – hare ellu shel baal habbayit. koves notel shelosha chutin – vehen shello, yater mikken – hare ellu shel baal habbayit. im haya shachor al gabbe hallavan – notel et hakkol vehen shello.

Hachayyayt sheshshiyyer et hachut kede litpor bo, umatlet shehi shalosh al shalosh – hare ellu shel baal habbayit. ma shehecharash motzi bemaatzad – hare ellu shello, uvechashshil – shel baal habbayit. veim haya ose etzel baal habbayit – af hannesarim shel baal habbayit.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: lokchin mochin min hakkoves, mippene shehen shello. hakkoves notel shene chutin haelyonim – vehen shello.
b: Velo yatil bo yoter mishshelosha chubbin, velo yisrok habbeged leshityo ella leerbo. umashvehu leorko, aval lo lerochbo. veim ba lehashevoto ad tefach – rashshay.
Amar mar: shene chutin. vehaanan tenan: shalosh! la kashya; ha beallime, veha bekattine.
Velo yisrok habbeged leshityo, ella leerbo. vehatanya ippecha! la kashya; ha biglima, ha besarbala.
Velo yatil bo yoter mishshelosha chubbin. bae rabbi yirmeya: amtoye veetoye chad, o dilma amtoye veetoye tere? teku.
Umashvehu leorko aval lo lerochbo. vehatanya ippecha! la kashya; ha biglima, ha behemyone.

Tanu rabbanan: en lokchin min hassorek mochin, mippene sheeno shello. uvimkom shennahagu lihyot shello – lokchin. uvechol makom lokchin mehen kar male mochin vecheset melea mochin. may tama? kenanhu beshinnuy.
Tanu rabbanan: en lokchin miggardi lo irin, velo nirin, velo punekalin, velo shiyyure pakyiyyot.
Aval lokchin mehen beged menummar, erev, usheti, tevivy, vearig.
Amri: hasheta tevivy shakli, arug mibbaya? may "arig" – tiche.

Tanu rabbanan: en lokchin min hatztzabba lo otot velo dugemot velo telushim shel tzemer, aval lokchin mehen beged tzavua, tevivy, begadim. hasheta tevivy shakel, begadim mibbaya? may "begadim" – namte.
Tanu rabbanan: hannoten orot leabbedan; hakkitztzuin vehattelushin – hare ellu shel baal habbayit, vehaole umishshattef bemayim – hare ellu shello.
Im haya shachor [vechulei]. amar rav yehuda: katztzara shemeh, vekatzra shakel leh. amar rav yehuda: hakkol olin leminyan techelet; veyitzchak beri kafed alayyhu.

Hachayyayt sheshshiyyer (min) [et] hachut kulei. vechamma litpor? amar rav assi: melo machat chutz lammachat. ibbaya lehu: melo machat, vechutz lammachat kimlo machat; o dilma melo machat, vechutz lammachat mashshehu?

Ta shema, detanya: hachayyayt sheshshiyyer et hachut pachot mikkede litpor bo, umatlet shehi pechuta mishshalosh al shalosh – bizman shebbaal habbayit makpid alehen, hare ellu shel baal habbayit; en baal habbayit makpid alehen, hare ellu shello.
I amrat bishlama melo machat, vechutz lammachat kimlo machat – pachot mikkan chaze lesikketa; ella i amrat melo machat, vechutz lammachat mashshehu – pachot mikkan lemay chaze?
Ella shema minna: melo machat, vechutz lammachat kimlo machat. shema minna.

Ma shehecharash kulei. ureminhi: ma shehecharash motzi bemaatzad, vehannifsak bimgera – hare ellu shel baal habbayit; vehayyotze mittachat makdeach umittachat rahitne, vehannigrar bimgera – hare ellu shello!
Amar rava: beatra detanna didan ikka tarte chatzine, lerabbati kare la "kashshil", ulezutarti kare la "maatzad". beatra detanna bara chad hu deikka, vekaru la "maatzad".

Veim haya ose etzel kulei. tanu rabbanan: mesattete avanim – en bahem mishshum gazel. mefassege ilanot, mefassege gefanim, menakkefe hige, menakkeshi zeraim veodre yerakot – bizman shebbaal habbayit makpid alehem, yesh bahen mishshum gazel; en baal habbayit makpid alehen, hare ellu shello.
Amar rav yehuda: keshut vachaziz – en bahem mishshum gazel. beatra dekafdi – yesh bahen mishshum gazel. amar ravina: umata machseya – atra dekafdi hu.
Hadaran alach haggozel batra uselika la massechet bava kamma

a: Shenayim ochazin betallit, ze omer: "ani metzatiha", veze omer: "ani metzatiha". ze omer: "kullah shelli", veze omer: "kullah shelli". ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah, veze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah – veyachloku.

Ze omer: "kullah shelli", veze omer: "chetzyah shelli", haomer kullah shelli – yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mishshelosha chalakim, vehaomer chetzyah shelli – yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mervia. ze notel shelosha chalakim, veze notel revia.

Hayu shenayim rochvin al gabbe behema, o shehaya echad rochev veechad manhig, ze omer: kullah shelli, veze omer: kullah shelli – ze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah, veze yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah, veyachloku.
Bizman shehem modim o sheyyesh lahen edim – cholkin belo shevua.

Gemara lema li lemitna ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha, ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli? litne chada! chada katane: ze omer ani metzatiha vechullah shelli, veze omer ani metzatiha vechullah shelli.

Velitne "ani metzatiha", vaana yadana dechullah shelli! i tena "ani metzatiha", hava amena: may "metzatiha" – reitiha. af al gav dela atay lideh – biriyya bealma kane, tena: "kullah shelli" – deviriyya la kane.
Umi matzet amrat may "metzatiha" – reitiha, veha amar ravnay "umetzatah" – daatay lideh mashma.

In "umetzatah" dikra – daata lideh mashma, umihu tanna lishshana dealma naket, umiddechaze leh amar: ana ashkachit, veaf al gav dela atay lideh biriyya bealma kane, tane: "kullah shelli" – deviriyya bealma la kane la.

Velitne "kullah shelli" vela bae "ani metzatiha"! i tane "kullah shelli" hava amena: bealma dekatane "metzatiha" biriyya bealma kane, tena "ani metzatiha" vahadar tena "kullah shelli" demimmishna yattira ashmeinan diriyya la kane.
Umi matzet amrat chada katane? veha "ze" veze" katane: "ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha, ze omer kullah shelli" vechulei.
Amar rav pappa, veittema rav shimi bar ashe, veamri la kedi: resha bimtzia, vesefa bemikkach umimkar.
Utzericha:
b: Dei tena metzia hava amena: metzia hu dirmo rabbanan shevua aleh mishshum demore veamar, chavray lav midde chasar bah, ezil etpis veitpeleg bahadeh! aval mikkach umimkar, delekka lememar hachi – ema la.

Vei tena mikkach umimkar, hu dirmo rabbanan shevua aleh mishshum demore veamar: chavray deme ka yahev vaana deme ka yahevna, hasheta ditzricha ledidi eshkeleh ana, vechavray lezil litrach lizban, aval metzia, delekka lememar hachi – ema la. tzericha.
Mikkach umimkar, velichze zuze mimman naket? la tzericha denaket mittarvayyhu, mechad middateh umechad beal karcheh, vela yadana mi hu middateh, umi hu beal karcheh.
Lema matnitin dela keven nannas, dei ben nannas, haamar:
Ketzad ellu vaellu bain lide shevuat shav?
Afillu tema ben nannas, hatam vadday ikka shevuat shav. hacha ikka lememar delekka shevuat shav, emor detarvayyhu bahade hadade agbehuha.
Lema matnitin dela kesomchos, dei kesomchos, haamar: mamon hammuttal besafek – cholkin belo shevua.
Veella may, rabbanan? ha amri hammotzi mechavero alav haraya!
Hay may, i amrat bishlama rabbanan: hatam dela tafsi tarvayyhu amaru rabbanan hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, hacha detarvayyhu tafsi [palgi] la bishvua.
Ella i amrat somchos, hasheta uma hatam dela tafsi tarvayyhu – cholkin belo shevua, hacha detarvayyhu tafsi la – lo kol shekken!
Afillu tema somchos: ki amar somchos shemma veshemma, aval bari uvari – la amar.
Ulerabba bar rav huna, deamar: amar somchos afillu bari uvari, may ikka lememar?
Afillu tema somchos, ki amar somchos – hecha deikka derara demamona, aval hecha delekka derara demamona – la.
Velav kal vachomer hu? uma hatam deikka derara demamona lemar, veikka derara demamona lemar,

a: Veikka lememar kullah lemar, veikka lememar kullah lemar, amar somchos: mamon hammuttal besafek cholkin belo shevua, hacha, delekka derara demamona, deikka lememar detarvayyhu hi, lo kol shekken!

Afillu tema somchos, shevua zo midderabbanan hi kidrabbi yochanan. deamar rabbi yochanan: shevua zo takkanat chachamim hi, shello yehe kol echad veechad holech vetokef betallito shel chavero veomer: shelli hu.
Lema matnitin dela kerabbi yose, dei kerabbi yose – ha amar: im ken ma hifsid rammay? ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu.
Ella may rabbanan – kevan deamri rabbanan: "hashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu", ha name kishar dame, disfeka hi!
Hay may? i amrat bishlama rabbanan, hatam devadday hay mane dechad minnayyhu hu amri rabbanan: yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. hacha deikka lememar detarvayyhu hu, amri rabbanan: palgi bishvua.

Ella i amrat rabbi yose hi, hasheta uma hatam divvadday ikka mane lemar veikka mane lemar, amar rabbi yose yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu, hacha deikka lememar dechad minnayyhu hu – lo kol shekken!
Afillu tema rabbi yose, hatam – vadday ikka rammay, hacha mi yemar deikka rammay? ema tarvayyhu bahade hadade agbehuha.
I name: hatam kanes leh rabbi yose lerammay ki hechi delode, hacha may peseda it leh delode.
Tinach metzia, mikkach umimkar may ikka lememar? ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.
Ben lerabbanan uven lerabbi yose, hatam gabbe chenvani al pinkaso dekatane: ze nishba venotel, veze nishba venotel.
May shena dela amrinan nappekeh lemamona mibbaal habbayit, vihe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu, deha bevadday ikka rammay!

Amri hatam, hayeynu tama deamar leh chenvani levaal habbayit: ana shelichuta didach ka avdina, may it li gabbe sachir, af al gav deka mishteva li, la meheman li bishvua, at heemanteh, dela amart li besahade hav leh.
Vesachir name amar leh levaal habbayit: ana avadi avidta gabbach, may it li gabbe chenvani, af al gav demishteva li la meheman li. hilkach, tarvayyhu mishtavi veshakli mibbaal habbayit.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: mane li beyadcha, vehalla omer: en lecha beyadi kelum, vehaedim meidim oto sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz – noten lo chamishshim zuz, veyishshava al hashshear.
Shello tehe hodaat piv gedola mehaadaat edim, mikkal vachomer.
Vetanna tuna: shenayim ochazin betallit ze omer ani metzatiha vechulei. veha hacha kevan detafes, anan sahadi demay detafes hay dideh hu, umay detafes hay dideh hu, vekatane: yishshava!
May "shello tehe hodaat piv gedola mehaadaat edim mikkal vachomer"? shello tomar hodaat piv hu deramya rachamana shevua aleh kidrabba.
Deamar rabba: mippene ma amra tora mode miktzat hattaana yishshava? chazaka en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo, vehay bechulleh bae denichpereh, veha dela kafreh – mishshum deen adam meiz panav
b: Vehay bechulleh bae delode leh. vehay dela odi – ishtemote hu deka mishtemet minneh, savar: ad dehavu li zuzi ufarana leh, veamar rachamana: remi shevua aleh ki hechi delode leh bechulleh,
Aval haadaat edim, delekka lememar hachi – ema la. ka mashma lan kal vachomer.
Umay kal vachomer? uma piv sheen mechayyeyvo mamon – mechayyeyvo shevua, edim shemmechayyeyvin oto mamon – eno din shemmechayyeyvin oto shevua?
Ufiv en mechayyeyvo mamon?! veha hodaat baal din kemea edim dame!
May "mamon" – kenas. uma piv sheen mechayyeyvo kenas, mechayyeyvo shevua! edim shemmechayyeyvin oto kenas, eno din shemmechayyeyvin oto shevua!
Ma lefiv – shekken mechayyeyvo korban, tomar beedim sheen mechayyeyvin oto korban!
Ha la kashya: rabbi chiyyay kerabbi meir sevira leh, deamar: edim mechayyeyvin oto korban mikkal vachomer.
Ditnan: amru lo shenayim "achalta chelev", vehu omer "lo achalti", rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrim.
Amar rabbi meir: im heviuhu shenayim lide mita chamura, lo yeviuhu lide korban hakkal? amru lo: ma im yirtze lomar "mezid hayiti" – yippater.
Ella: ma lefiv – shekken mechayyeyvo asham! asham hayeynu korban.
Ella: ma lefiv – shekken mechayyeyvo chomesh. ha la kashya, rabbi chiyyay kerabbi meir sevira leh, ki hechi dimchayyev leh korban mikkal vachomer – mechayyev leh chomesh mikkal vachomer.
Ella: ma lefiv – shekken eno behachechasha uvahazama, tomar beedim sheyyeshnan behachechasha uvahazama.
Ella atya meed echad: uma ed echad sheen mechayyeyvo mamon, mechayyeyvo shevua – edim shemmechayyeyvin oto mamon, eno din shemmechayyeyvin oto shevua!
Ma leed echad shekken al ma shehu meid hu nishba,

a: Tomar beedim, sheal ma shekkafar hu nishba.
Ella amar rav pappa: ate miggilgul shevua deed echad.
Ma legilgul shevua deed echad, shekken shevua goreret shevua, tomar beedim – demamon ka mechayyeyvi!
Piv yochiach. ma lefiv shekken eno behachechasha – ed echad yochiach sheyyeshno behachechasha umechayyeyvo shevua.
Ma leed echad, shekken al ma shemmeid hu nishba, tomar beedim – sheal ma shekkafar hu nishba! piv yochiach.
Vechazar haddin: lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheal yede taana uchefira hen bain, venishba. af ani avi edim, sheal yede taana uchefira hem bain – venishba.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken lo huchezak kafran. tomar beedim shekken huchezak kafran.
Uveedim mi huchezak kafran! vehaamar rav idi bar avin amar rav chisda: hakkofer bemilve – kasher leedut. befikkadon – pasul leedut.
Ella parech hachi: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken enan betorat hazama, tomar beedim sheyyeshnan betorat hazama!
Ha la kashya: rabbi chiyyay torat hazama la parech.

Ella dekaamar vetanna tuna mi dame? hatam lemalve it leh sahade, lelove let leh sahade dela massek leh vela midde, dei havo leh sahade lelove dela massek leh vela midde – la bae rabbi chiyyay leishtevoe, hacha ki hechi daanan sahade behay – anan sahade behay, vaafillu hachi mishtavi!
Ella ki ittemar "vetanna tuna" – aiddach derabbi chiyyay ittemar, deamar rabbi chiyyay: "mane li beyadcha" vehalla omer: "en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim zuz, vehelach" – chayyayv.
May tama – "helach" name kemode miktzat hatteana dame.
Vetanna tuna: shenayim ochazin betallit.
Veha hacha, kevan detafes – anan sahade demay detafes helach hu, vekatane: yishshava.

Verav sheshet amar "helach patur". may tama? kevan deamar leh "helach", hane zuzi deka mode begavvayyhu – keman denaket lehu malve dame. beinach chamishshim ha la mode, hilkach lekka hodaat miktzat hatteana.
Ulerav sheshet kashya matnitin! amar lecha rav sheshet: matnitin takkanat chachamim hi.

Veiddach? in takkanat chachamim hi. umihu, i amrat bishlama middeorayyta "helach" chayyayv – metakkeni rabbanan shevua keen deorayyta, ella i amrat middeorayyta "helach" patur – metakkeni rabbanan shevua deleta dichvota bidorayyta?
Metivi:
b: Selaim, dinarin. malve omer chamesh, velove omer shalosh. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: hoil vehoda miktzat hatteana – yishshava. rabbi akiva omer: eno ella kemeshiv aveda, ufatur.
Katane mihat: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, hoil vehoda miktzat hatteana – yishshava. tama deamar shalosh, ha shetayim patur, vehay shetar dekamode beh helach hu, ushema minna helach patur!
La, leolam ema lach shetayim chayyayv, vehay dekatane shalosh, leappoke midderabbi akiva, deamar: meshiv aveda have ufatur, ka mashma lan demode miktzat hatteana have, vechayyayv.
I hachi: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: hoil vehoda miktzat hatteana yishshava, "af ze yishshava" mibbee leh!
Ella: leolam shetayim patur, vehelach chayyayv. veshane hacha, deka mesayyay leh shetara.
I name: mishshum dehave leh shetar shibud karkaot, veen nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot.
Ikka demotev missefa, rabbi akiva omer: eno ella kemeshiv aveda ufatur. tama deamar shalosh, ha shetayim chayyayv. veha shetar, kevan deka mode beh kehelach" dame, shema minna "helach" chayyayv!
La, leolam ema lach shetayim name patur, vehay dekatane shalosh, leappoke midderabbi shimon ben elazar, deamar mode miktzat hattaana have – vechayyayv, ka mashma lan demeshiv aveda have – ufatur.

Hachi name mistabbera. dei salka datach: shetayim chayyayv, beshalosh hechi patar leh rabbi akiva, hay iarome ka maarim! savar: i amena shetayim baena ishtevoe, ema shalosh deehve kemeshiv aveda, veippater. ella shema minna: shetayim name patur.
Ella kashya lerabbi chiyyay! shane hatam deka mesayyay leh shetara. i name mishshum dehave leh shetar shibud karkaot, veen nishbain al kefirat shibud karkaot.
Metiv mar zutera bereh derav nachman: teano kelim vekarkaot, hoda bakkelim vechafar bakkarkaot, hoda bakkarkaot vechafar bakkelim – patur. hoda miktzat karkaot – patur, miktzat kelim – chayyayv.
Tama dechelim vekarkaot, dekarka lav bat shevua hi, ha kelim vechelim dumeya dechelim vekarkaot chayyayv. hechi dame? lav deamar leh helach, ushema minna helach chayyayv!
La, leolam ema lach kelim vechelim name patur, veha dekatane kelim vekarkaot, ha ka mashma lan: hoda bemiktzat kelim – chayyayv af al hakkarkaot.
May ka mashma lan – zokkin? tenena: zokkin hannechasim sheen lahen achrayut et hannechasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut lishshava alehem.
Hacha ikkar, hatam aggav gerara nasva.
